question:
Write a PL/SQL procedure that retrieves and prints the most recent average exchange rate between two currencies from ADVENTUREWORKS.CURRENCYRATE using an inline view.

Requirements:
   Procedure Name: sp_get_current_rate

  Parameters:
    p_from  IN  VARCHAR2  -- origin currency used to filter exchange rate lookup
    p_to    IN  VARCHAR2  -- destination currency used to filter exchange rate lookup

  Output:
    Prints 'Current Rate: [lv_rate]' if a valid rate is found
    Prints 'Invalid rate detected' if the retrieved rate is NULL or 0

  Sorting Rules:
    ORDER BY CurrencyRateDate DESC, first row only via inline view

  Exception Handling:
    No data found:      Prints 'Exchange rate not found for <p_from> to <p_to>'
    Unexpected failure: Prints 'Unexpected error occurred'
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp_get_current_rate (
    p_from IN VARCHAR2,
    p_to   IN VARCHAR2
) IS
    lv_rate NUMBER;
BEGIN
    -- Retrieve the most recent average rate for the currency pair
    -- Uses an inline view to sort by date descending, then takes the top row
    SELECT AverageRate
    INTO lv_rate
    FROM (
        SELECT AverageRate
        FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.CURRENCYRATE
        WHERE FromCurrencyCode = p_from
          AND ToCurrencyCode = p_to
        ORDER BY CurrencyRateDate DESC
    )
    WHERE ROWNUM = 1;

    -- Output the result
    -- Validation: Check if rate is valid (not null or 0)
    IF lv_rate IS NULL OR lv_rate = 0 THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid rate detected');
    ELSE
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Current Rate: ' || lv_rate);
    END IF;
EXCEPTION
    -- Handle case where the currency pair does not exist
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Exchange rate not found for ' || p_from || ' to ' || p_to);
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        -- Handle any unexpected errors
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error occurred');
END;
/

Extend the existing logic and update sp_get_current_rate to also fetch CurrencyRateDate into a TIMESTAMP variable and include it in the output, and update the invalid rate message.
Use object type, object type body to make more complex logic.

Requirements:
  Procedure Name: sp_get_current_rate

  Parameters:
    p_from  IN  VARCHAR2  -- origin currency, wrapped in UPPER() in WHERE clause
    p_to    IN  VARCHAR2  -- destination currency, wrapped in UPPER() in WHERE clause
  
   Object Type: obj_currency_rate 
          (from_currency     VARCHAR2(10),
           to_currency       VARCHAR2(10),
           rate_value        NUMBER,
           rate_date         TIMESTAMP,
    MEMBER FUNCTION is_valid RETURN BOOLEAN)

  Output:
    Prints 'Rate: <lv_rate> on <TO_CHAR(lv_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')>' 
     If a valid rate is found Print: 'Rate invalid or not set' if the retrieved rate is NULL or 0

  Sorting Rules:
    ORDER BY CurrencyRateDate DESC, first row only via inline view

  Exception Handling:
    No data found:      Prints 'Exchange rate not found for <UPPER(p_from)> to <UPPER(p_to)>'
    Unexpected failure: Prints 'Unexpected error occurred'
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE TYPE obj_currency_rate AS OBJECT (
    from_currency     VARCHAR2(10),
    to_currency       VARCHAR2(10),
    rate_value        NUMBER,
    rate_date         TIMESTAMP,

    -- Member function to validate rate
    MEMBER FUNCTION is_valid RETURN BOOLEAN
);
/
CREATE OR REPLACE TYPE BODY obj_currency_rate AS

    MEMBER FUNCTION is_valid RETURN BOOLEAN IS
    BEGIN
        IF rate_value IS NULL OR rate_value = 0 THEN
            RETURN FALSE;
        ELSE
            RETURN TRUE;
        END IF;
    END;

END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp_get_current_rate (
    p_from IN VARCHAR2,
    p_to   IN VARCHAR2
)
IS
    -- Object instance
    lv_rate_obj obj_currency_rate;

    -- Local variables
    lv_rate NUMBER;
    lv_date TIMESTAMP;

BEGIN
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- FETCH LATEST RATE USING INLINE VIEW + ORDER BY
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT AverageRate, CurrencyRateDate
    INTO lv_rate, lv_date
    FROM (
        SELECT AverageRate, CurrencyRateDate
        FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.CURRENCYRATE
        WHERE FromCurrencyCode = UPPER(p_from)
          AND ToCurrencyCode = UPPER(p_to)
        ORDER BY CurrencyRateDate DESC
    )
    WHERE ROWNUM = 1;

    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ASSIGN OBJECT
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    lv_rate_obj := obj_currency_rate(
        UPPER(p_from),
        UPPER(p_to),
        lv_rate,
        lv_date
    );

    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- VALIDATION USING OBJECT METHOD
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF lv_rate_obj.is_valid THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
            'Rate: ' || lv_rate_obj.rate_value ||
            ' on ' || TO_CHAR(lv_rate_obj.rate_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
        );
    ELSE
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Rate invalid or not set');
    END IF;

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- EXCEPTION HANDLING
----------------------------------------------------------------------
EXCEPTION

    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
            'Exchange rate not found for ' ||
            UPPER(p_from) || ' to ' || UPPER(p_to)
        );

    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error occurred');

END sp_get_current_rate;
/

question:
Create a PL/SQL solution to retrieve and display customer purchase details for a selected customer by joining customer, invoice, invoice item, and track data with deterministic no-data and unexpected-error handling.

Requirements:
  Anonymous Block:
    Parameters:
      1. lv_customer_id NUMBER -- customer identifier declared in the block and used to filter purchases

  Output:
    On success, print one line per purchase in this format:
    CUSTOMER: <customer_name> | EMAIL: <email> | INVOICE ID: <invoiceid> | INVOICE DATE: <invoicedate> | TRACK: <track_name> | UNIT PRICE: <unitprice>

  Sorting Rules:
    ORDER BY invoiceid ASC

  Exception Handling:
    No purchases found: DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('NO PURCHASE DETAILS FOUND FOR THE GIVEN CUSTOMER ID.')
    Unexpected failure: DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error occurred')
reference_answer:
DECLARE
    lv_customer_id NUMBER := 5;
    lv_is_found    BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
    FOR rec_purchase IN (
        SELECT
            c.firstname || ' ' || c.lastname AS customer_name,
            c.email,
            i.invoiceid,
            i.invoicedate,
            t.name AS track_name,
            ii.unitprice
        FROM CHINOOK.CUSTOMERS c
        JOIN CHINOOK.INVOICES i
            ON c.customerid = i.customerid
        JOIN CHINOOK.INVOICE_ITEMS ii
            ON i.invoiceid = ii.invoiceid
        JOIN CHINOOK.TRACKS t
            ON ii.trackid = t.trackid
        WHERE c.customerid = lv_customer_id
        ORDER BY i.invoiceid
    ) LOOP
        lv_is_found := TRUE;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
            'CUSTOMER: ' || rec_purchase.customer_name ||
            ' | EMAIL: ' || rec_purchase.email ||
            ' | INVOICE ID: ' || rec_purchase.invoiceid ||
            ' | INVOICE DATE: ' || rec_purchase.invoicedate ||
            ' | TRACK: ' || rec_purchase.track_name ||
            ' | UNIT PRICE: ' || rec_purchase.unitprice
        );
    END LOOP;

    IF NOT lv_is_found THEN
        RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
    END IF;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('NO PURCHASE DETAILS FOUND FOR THE GIVEN CUSTOMER ID.');
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error occurred');
END;
/

Create a PL/SQL procedure that calculates total delivered distance for each driver and prints only the top 50 drivers with the highest total distance.

Requirements:
  Procedure Name: sp_total_delivery_distance_dtl

  Output:
    On success, print one line per driver in this format:
    Driver ID: <driver_id> | Total Distance: <total_distance> meters

  Sorting Rules:
    ORDER BY total_distance DESC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY

  Exception Handling:
    Unexpected failure: DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error occurred')
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp_total_delivery_distance_dtl
IS
BEGIN
    FOR rec_driver IN (
        SELECT d.driver_id,
               SUM(d.delivery_distance_meters) AS total_distance
        FROM DELIVERY_CENTER.DELIVERIES d
        WHERE d.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED'
        GROUP BY d.driver_id
        ORDER BY total_distance DESC
        FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY
    ) LOOP
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
            'Driver ID: ' || rec_driver.driver_id ||
            ' | Total Distance: ' || rec_driver.total_distance ||
            ' meters'
        );
    END LOOP;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error occurred');
END;
/

reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp_total_delivery_distance_dtl
(
    p_driver_type IN VARCHAR2
)
IS
    lv_count NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
    FOR rec_driver IN (
        SELECT d.driver_id,
               d.driver_type,
               d.driver_modal,
               SUM(del.delivery_distance_meters) AS total_distance
        FROM DELIVERY_CENTER.DELIVERIES del
        JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.DRIVERS d
            ON del.driver_id = d.driver_id
        WHERE del.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED'
          AND d.driver_type = p_driver_type
        GROUP BY
            d.driver_id,
            d.driver_type,
            d.driver_modal
        ORDER BY total_distance DESC
        FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY
    ) LOOP
        lv_count := lv_count + 1;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
            'Driver ID: ' || rec_driver.driver_id ||
            ' | Type: ' || rec_driver.driver_type ||
            ' | Modal: ' || rec_driver.driver_modal ||
            ' | Total Distance: ' || rec_driver.total_distance ||
            ' meters'
        );
    END LOOP;

    IF lv_count = 0 THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
            'No delivered orders found for driver type: ' || p_driver_type
        );
    END IF;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error occurred');
END;

Construct an anonymous PL/SQL block that generates a summarized report of the top 10 wrestling events based on card volume within the WWE schema. The logic must perform an inner join between the events and cards tables and use anchored data types for local variables.

Requirements:
Anonymous Block Name : Anonymous PL/SQL Block

Parameters:
lv_promo_input An internal variable anchored to WWE.CARDS.promotion_id%TYPE, initialized to a numeric value (e.g., 1) to filter the dataset.

Output:
Format: A string output for each record showing the Event Name, Card Count, and associated metadata (Table, Location, and URL).

Exception Handling:
WHEN OTHERS: Implement a general exception handler to catch all unexpected system errors. This block must return the static string: 'Unexpected error occurred' and is strictly prohibited from using SQLERRM.
reference_answer:
DECLARE
    lv_promo_input WWE.CARDS.promotion_id%TYPE := 1;
    v_data_found   BOOLEAN := FALSE;

    CURSOR c_promo_events IS
        WITH ev AS (
            SELECT
                e.id   AS event_id,
                e.name AS event_name,
                COUNT(*) AS total_cards
            FROM WWE.EVENTS e
            JOIN WWE.CARDS c
                ON c.event_id = e.id
            WHERE c.promotion_id = lv_promo_input
            GROUP BY e.id, e.name
        ),
        top10 AS (
            SELECT
                event_id,
                event_name,
                total_cards
            FROM ev
            ORDER BY total_cards DESC
            FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
        )
        SELECT
            t.event_name,
            t.total_cards,
            c.table_id    AS sample_table,
            c.location_id AS sample_location,
            c.url         AS sample_url
        FROM top10 t
        JOIN WWE.CARDS c
            ON c.event_id = t.event_id
           AND c.promotion_id = lv_promo_input
        WHERE c.id = (
            SELECT MIN(c2.id)
            FROM WWE.CARDS c2
            WHERE c2.event_id = t.event_id
              AND c2.promotion_id = lv_promo_input
        )
        ORDER BY t.total_cards DESC;
BEGIN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('--- WWE EVENT SUMMARY FOR PROMOTION ID: ' || lv_promo_input || ' ---');

    FOR rec IN c_promo_events LOOP
        v_data_found := TRUE;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
            'Event: '    || rec.event_name ||
            ' | Cards: ' || rec.total_cards ||
            ' | Table: ' || rec.sample_table ||
            ' | Loc: '   || rec.sample_location ||
            ' | URL: '   || rec.sample_url
        );
    END LOOP;

    IF NOT v_data_found THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No event data found for the specified promotion.');
    END IF;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error occurred');
END;
/

Construct an anonymous PL/SQL block to summarize Bitcoin transaction activity from the BANK_SALES_TRADING schema. The block must identify transaction metrics for members associated with a specific asset ticker and handle the output through a cursor loop. Aggregate the data to calculate the total quantity, transaction count, and average percentage fee per member. Order the final summary by the member's first name to ensure a consistent output sequence for every execution.Use a boolean flag within the loop to determine if any records were processed.

Requirements:

Anonymous Block Name : Anonymous PL/SQL Block

Parameters: 
A local variable anchored to the BANK_SALES_TRADING.BITCOIN_TRANSACTIONS.ticker column, initialized to a specific value (e.g., 'BTC') to filter the dataset.

Output:
Iterate through the results and print the member name alongside all calculated transaction metrics using DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE. If no matching records are found for the provided ticker, display the message: 'No transaction data found for the specified ticker.'.

Exception Handling:
 Include a WHEN OTHERS exception block to catch unexpected system failures. This block must print the static message: 'Unexpected error occurred' .

DECLARE
    -- [Memory & Type]
    -- [Data Synchronization]
    lv_ticker_input BANK_SALES_TRADING.BITCOIN_TRANSACTIONS.ticker%TYPE := 'ETH';
    v_data_found    BOOLEAN := FALSE;

    -- [Cursors]
    -- [Data Retrieval]
    CURSOR c_ticker_summary IS
        SELECT m.first_name,
               SUM(t.quantity) AS total_qty,
               COUNT(t.txn_id) AS txn_count,
               AVG(t.percentage_fee) AS avg_fee,
               MAX(t.txn_type) AS last_type,
               MAX(t.txn_id) AS sample_txn
        FROM BANK_SALES_TRADING.BITCOIN_MEMBERS m
        JOIN BANK_SALES_TRADING.BITCOIN_TRANSACTIONS t
          ON m.member_id = t.member_id
        WHERE t.ticker = lv_ticker_input
        GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name 
        ORDER BY m.first_name;
BEGIN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('--- TRANSACTION SUMMARY FOR TICKER: ' || lv_ticker_input || ' ---');

    -- [Iterative]
    FOR rec IN c_ticker_summary LOOP
        v_data_found := TRUE;
        
        -- [Control Flow]
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
            'Member: '      || rec.first_name ||
            ' | Total Qty: '|| rec.total_qty ||
            ' | Txns: '     || rec.txn_count ||
            ' | Avg Fee: '  || ROUND(rec.avg_fee, 4) ||
            ' | Type: '     || rec.last_type ||
            ' | ID: '       || rec.sample_txn
        );
    END LOOP;

    -- [Decision Logic]
    IF NOT v_data_found THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No transaction data found for the specified ticker.');
    END IF;

EXCEPTION
    -- [Exception Handling]
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        -- SQLERRM strictly excluded per project mandate
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error occurred');
END;

Write a plsql procedure to retrieve customer pizza order details and categorize them as Veg or Non-Veg.
Requirements

Procedure name:
sp_pizza_dtls  

Purpose:
Fetches pizza details along with customer IDs, applies business classification rules, and prints results.  

Cursor:
cur_trans -> retrieves pizza_id, pizza_name, and customer_id from modern_data.pizza_names joined with modern_data.pizza_customer_orders, ordered by pizza_id.  

Variables:
l_status -> classification status (Veg/Non Veg/Unknown)  



Output Format:
<pizza_id>,<pizza_name>,<customer_id>,<l_status>  
*(Printed for each record in cursor)*  

Exception Handling Output:
OTHERS -> 'Error while processing pizza details'  
*(Printed when any unexpected error occurs; exception is re-raised after logging)*
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp_pizza_dtls IS l_status VARCHAR2(200); CURSOR cur_trans IS SELECT pz.pizza_id, pz.pizza_name, pco.customer_id FROM modern_data.pizza_names pz JOIN modern_data.pizza_customer_orders pco ON pz.pizza_id = pco.pizza_id ORDER BY pz.pizza_id; BEGIN FOR i IN cur_trans LOOP IF upper(i.pizza_name) = 'MEATLOVERS' THEN l_status := 'Non Veg'; ELSIF upper(i.pizza_name) = 'VEGETARIAN' THEN l_status := 'Veg'; ELSE l_status := 'Unknown'; END IF; dbms_output.put_line(i.pizza_id || ',' || i.pizza_name || ',' || i.customer_id || ',' || l_status); END LOOP; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN dbms_output.put_line('Error while processing pizza details'); END sp_pizza_dtls;
/
tests:
SET SERVEROUTPUT ON;
EXEC sp_pizza_dtls;

Write a PL/SQL anonymous block that retrieves and prints the total points scored by a specific F1 driver for a given season year by joining F1.RESULTS and F1.RACES, with a NULL guard to handle seasons with no recorded data.

Requirements:
  Type: Anonymous Block

  Parameters:
    - None (uses lv_driver_id NUMBER := 1 and lv_year NUMBER := 2008)

  Output:
    - Prints 'Driver ID: [lv_driver_id] | Year: [lv_year] | Total Points: 
      [lv_total_points]' if data is found
    - Prints 'No data found for Driver ID [lv_driver_id] in [lv_year].' if 
      SUM returns NULL or no rows match

  Exception Handling:
    - No data found:      Raises NO_DATA_FOUND when lv_total_points IS NULL; 
                          prints 'No data found for Driver ID [lv_driver_id] 
                          in [lv_year].'
    - Unexpected failure: Prints 'Unexpected error occurred.'
reference_answer:
DECLARE
    -- Input Variables
    lv_driver_id NUMBER := 1;    -- Lewis Hamilton's ID
    lv_year      NUMBER := 2008; -- Championship Year

    -- Output Variable
    lv_total_points NUMBER;
BEGIN
    -- Sum points for the specific driver ID and year from tables (RESULTS and RACES)
    SELECT SUM(res.points)
    INTO lv_total_points
    FROM F1.RESULTS res
    JOIN F1.RACES r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE res.driver_id = lv_driver_id
      AND r.year = lv_year;

    -- Validation: SUM returns NULL if no rows match
    IF lv_total_points IS NULL THEN
        RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
    END IF;

    -- Output
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Driver ID: ' || lv_driver_id || ' | Year: ' || lv_year || ' | Total Points: ' || lv_total_points);
EXCEPTION
    -- Exception Handling
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found for Driver ID ' || lv_driver_id || ' in ' || lv_year || '.');
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error occurred.');
END;
/

question:
Enhance the PL/SQL function to retrieve and display an extended member profile for a given member ID. The function should now also include the member's transaction summary showing their total number of transactions, total buy count, total sell count and total quantity traded and return all information in a clear and readable message.
Requirements:
Function Name: sf_get_member_txn_profile
Parameters: Accept a single input parameter for the member ID (p_member_id) as a VARCHAR2.
Output: The function must return a VARCHAR2 value containing the extended member profile information. The returned message must display the member details in the following format:
"Member ID:"
"First Name:"
"Region:"
"Region Type:"
"Total Transactions:"
"Total Buys:"
"Total Sells:"
"Total Quantity:"
Processing Logic: Retrieve member information from BANK_SALES_TRADING.BITCOIN_MEMBERS. Fetch the following columns: FIRST_NAME, REGION. Store these values in local variables. Apply the following classification logic: If REGION is 'Asia' or 'Africa' return "Emerging". If REGION is 'United States' or 'Australia' return "Established". Otherwise return "Other". Additionally retrieve transaction summary from BANK_SALES_TRADING.BITCOIN_TRANSACTIONS for the given member using COUNT(*) as total transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'BUY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total buys, SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'SELL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total sells and NVL(SUM(quantity), 0) as total quantity traded. Store all values in local variables.
Exception Handling: If p_member_id is NULL, return the message: "Member ID null not found." If no data exists for the given member ID, handle the NO_DATA_FOUND exception and return: "Member ID: [ID] no data found". For any other unexpected runtime error, handle the exception using WHEN OTHERS and return: "Unexpected error occurred"
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sf_get_member_txn_profile(
    p_member_id VARCHAR2
)
RETURN VARCHAR2
IS
    lv_first_name    VARCHAR2(50);  -- member first name
    lv_region        VARCHAR2(50);  -- member region
    lv_region_type   VARCHAR2(20);  -- derived region classification
    lv_total_txn     NUMBER(38);    -- total number of transactions
    lv_total_buys    NUMBER(38);    -- total buy transactions
    lv_total_sells   NUMBER(38);    -- total sell transactions
    lv_total_qty     NUMBER;        -- total quantity traded
BEGIN
    IF p_member_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN 'Member ID null not found.';
    END IF;

    SELECT first_name, region
    INTO   lv_first_name, lv_region
    FROM   BANK_SALES_TRADING.BITCOIN_MEMBERS
    WHERE  member_id = p_member_id;

    IF lv_region IN ('Asia', 'Africa') THEN
        lv_region_type := 'Emerging';
    ELSIF lv_region IN ('United States', 'Australia') THEN
        lv_region_type := 'Established';
    ELSE
        lv_region_type := 'Other';
    END IF;

    SELECT COUNT(*),
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'BUY'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'SELL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
           NVL(SUM(quantity), 0)
    INTO   lv_total_txn, lv_total_buys, lv_total_sells, lv_total_qty
    FROM   BANK_SALES_TRADING.BITCOIN_TRANSACTIONS
    WHERE  member_id = p_member_id;

    RETURN 'Member ID: '          || p_member_id    || CHR(10) ||
           'First Name: '         || lv_first_name  || CHR(10) ||
           'Region: '             || lv_region      || CHR(10) ||
           'Region Type: '        || lv_region_type || CHR(10) ||
           'Total Transactions: ' || lv_total_txn   || CHR(10) ||
           'Total Buys: '         || lv_total_buys  || CHR(10) ||
           'Total Sells: '        || lv_total_sells || CHR(10) ||
           'Total Quantity: '     || lv_total_qty;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RETURN 'Member ID: ' || p_member_id || ' no data found';
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RETURN 'Unexpected error occurred';
END sf_get_member_txn_profile;
/

Requirements:
Function Name: sf_get_member_full_profile
Parameters: Accept a single input parameter for the member ID (p_member_id) as a VARCHAR2.
Output: The function must return a VARCHAR2 value containing the full member trading profile information. The returned message must display the member details in the following format:
"Member ID:"
"First Name:"
"Region:"
"Region Type:"
"Total Transactions:"
"Total Buys:"
"Total Sells:"

"Latest Price:"
"Avg Fee %:"
Processing Logic: Retrieve member information from BANK_SALES_TRADING.BITCOIN_MEMBERS. Fetch the following columns: FIRST_NAME, REGION. Store these values in local variables. Apply the following classification logic: If REGION is 'Asia' or 'Africa' return "Emerging". If REGION is 'United States' or 'Australia' return "Established". Otherwise return "Other". Additionally retrieve transaction summary from BANK_SALES_TRADING.BITCOIN_TRANSACTIONS for the given member using COUNT() as total transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'BUY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total buys, SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'SELL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total sells, NVL(SUM(quantity), 0) as total quantity and ROUND(NVL(AVG(percentage_fee), 0), 2) as average fee. Retrieve the most traded ticker for the member by selecting the ticker with the highest COUNT() from BITCOIN_TRANSACTIONS grouped by ticker using FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ordered by COUNT(*) DESC. Then retrieve the latest market price for that ticker from BANK_SALES_TRADING.BITCOIN_PRICES by selecting price ordered by market_date DESC using FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY. Store all values in local variables.
Exception Handling: If p_member_id is NULL, return the message: "Member ID null not found." If no data exists for the given member ID, handle the NO_DATA_FOUND exception and return: "Member ID: [ID] no data found". For any other unexpected runtime error, handle the exception using WHEN OTHERS and return: "Unexpected error occurred"
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sf_get_member_full_profile(
    p_member_id VARCHAR2
)
RETURN VARCHAR2
IS
    lv_first_name    VARCHAR2(50);   -- member first name
    lv_region        VARCHAR2(50);   -- member region
    lv_region_type   VARCHAR2(20);   -- derived region classification
    lv_total_txn     NUMBER(38);     -- total number of transactions
    lv_total_buys    NUMBER(38);     -- total buy transactions
    lv_total_sells   NUMBER(38);     -- total sell transactions
    lv_total_qty     NUMBER;         -- total quantity traded
    lv_avg_fee       NUMBER;         -- average percentage fee paid
    lv_top_ticker    VARCHAR2(20);   -- most traded ticker
    lv_latest_price  NUMBER;         -- latest market price for top ticker
BEGIN
    IF p_member_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN 'Member ID null not found.';
    END IF;

    SELECT first_name, region
    INTO   lv_first_name, lv_region
    FROM   BANK_SALES_TRADING.BITCOIN_MEMBERS
    WHERE  member_id = p_member_id;

    IF lv_region IN ('Asia', 'Africa') THEN
        lv_region_type := 'Emerging';
    ELSIF lv_region IN ('United States', 'Australia') THEN
        lv_region_type := 'Established';
    ELSE
        lv_region_type := 'Other';
    END IF;

    SELECT COUNT(*),
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'BUY'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'SELL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
           NVL(SUM(quantity), 0),
           ROUND(NVL(AVG(percentage_fee), 0), 2)
    INTO   lv_total_txn, lv_total_buys, lv_total_sells,
           lv_total_qty, lv_avg_fee
    FROM   BANK_SALES_TRADING.BITCOIN_TRANSACTIONS
    WHERE  member_id = p_member_id;

    SELECT ticker
    INTO   lv_top_ticker
    FROM   BANK_SALES_TRADING.BITCOIN_TRANSACTIONS
    WHERE  member_id = p_member_id
    GROUP BY ticker
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY;

    SELECT price
    INTO   lv_latest_price
    FROM   BANK_SALES_TRADING.BITCOIN_PRICES
    WHERE  ticker = lv_top_ticker
    ORDER BY market_date DESC
    FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY;

    RETURN 'Member ID: '          || p_member_id     || CHR(10) ||
           'First Name: '         || lv_first_name   || CHR(10) ||
           'Region: '             || lv_region       || CHR(10) ||
           'Region Type: '        || lv_region_type  || CHR(10) ||
           'Total Transactions: ' || lv_total_txn    || CHR(10) ||
           'Total Buys: '         || lv_total_buys   || CHR(10) ||
           'Total Sells: '        || lv_total_sells  || CHR(10) ||
           'Total Quantity: '     || lv_total_qty    || CHR(10) ||
           'Top Ticker: '         || lv_top_ticker   || CHR(10) ||
           'Latest Price: '       || lv_latest_price || CHR(10) ||
           'Avg Fee %: '          || lv_avg_fee;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RETURN 'Member ID: ' || p_member_id || ' no data found';
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RETURN 'Unexpected error occurred';
END sf_get_member_full_profile;
/

Enhance the existing PL/SQL function to a new function that allows a user to enter a Trip ID to analyze the trip duration, start station, end station, and subscriber type for a bikeshare trip. The report should display the trip details and also calculate the average trip duration for the same subscriber type. If the trip details are missing, the function should return a clear message.

Requirements:
Function Name: sf_fn_trip_analysis.

Parameters: Accept a single input parameter for the Trip's ID ("p_trip_id") as a "VARCHAR2".

Output: Use "RETURN" to print a formatted result. All field labels must be formatted exactly as: "Trip ID:", "Trip Duration:", "Start:", "End:", "Type:", and "Avg Duration". The report must display the trip details along with the average duration for trips belonging to the same subscriber type.

Processing Logic: Retrieve trip data from "san_francisco.bikeshare_trips" using an inline view. Fetch the columns "duration_sec", "start_station_name", "end_station_name", and "subscriber_type". Store the retrieved values in the variables "v_duration", "v_start", "v_end", and "v_type". Then calculate the average duration for trips that have the same subscriber type by retrieving data again from "san_francisco.bikeshare_trips" using another inline view. Convert "duration_sec" to a numeric value and calculate the average duration. Store the result in the variable "v_avg". The final output must display the trip details along with the average duration for that subscriber type. The average duration must be displayed using ROUND to two decimal places.

Exception Handling: If the "p_trip_id" is NULL, the function must return the message: "Trip id NULL not found". If the specified Trip ID does not exist in the "san_francisco.bikeshare_trips" table, return the message: "Trip ID: [ID] not found". For any other unexpected runtime error, handle the exception using "WHEN OTHERS" and return the fixed message: "Unexpected error occurred".
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sf_fn_trip_analysis (
    p_trip_id VARCHAR2
)
RETURN VARCHAR2
IS
    v_duration VARCHAR2(20);
    v_start    VARCHAR2(100);
    v_end      VARCHAR2(100);
    v_type     VARCHAR2(50);
    v_avg      NUMBER;
BEGIN

    -- INPUT VALIDATION
    IF p_trip_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN 'Trip id NULL not found';
    END IF;

    -- DATA RETRIEVAL using INLINE VIEW
    SELECT duration_sec,
           start_station_name,
           end_station_name,
           subscriber_type
    INTO   v_duration,
           v_start,
           v_end,
           v_type
    FROM (
            SELECT duration_sec,
                   start_station_name,
                   end_station_name,
                   subscriber_type,
                   trip_id
            FROM san_francisco.bikeshare_trips
         )
    WHERE trip_id = p_trip_id;

    -- INLINE VIEW for average calculation
    SELECT AVG(duration_val)
    INTO v_avg
    FROM (
            SELECT TO_NUMBER(duration_sec) duration_val
            FROM san_francisco.bikeshare_trips
            WHERE subscriber_type = v_type
            AND duration_sec IS NOT NULL
         );

    RETURN 'Trip ID: '||p_trip_id||chr(10)||
           'Trip Duration: '||NVL(v_duration,'NULL')||chr(10)||
           'Start: '||v_start||chr(10)||
           'End: '||v_end||chr(10)||
           'Type: '||v_type||chr(10)||
           'Avg Duration: '||NVL(TO_CHAR(ROUND(v_avg,2)),'No duration data');

EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RETURN 'Trip ID: '||p_trip_id||' '||'not found';

    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RETURN 'Unexpected error occurred';

END sf_fn_trip_analysis;
/

Some births values may be non-numeric, so treat them as bad data and skip them, but still count how many rows were skipped. Limit the output to a readable number of rows.

Requirements

Script purpose:

- Handle non-numeric values gracefully
- Print summary of printed vs skipped rows

Variables:
- lv_year → target year (DATE type, initialized to 2019-01-01)
- lv_county_like → filter for county_of_residence (default '%')

- lv_printed_rows → counter for printed rows
- lv_births_num → numeric conversion of births

Execution Logic:

2. Query COUNTY_NATALITY:

   - Filter by county_of_residence LIKE lv_county_like
   - Order by births DESC
3. Loop through results:
   - Attempt to convert births to NUMBER
   - If successful:
     - Increment lv_printed_rows

   - If conversion fails (VALUE_ERROR, INVALID_NUMBER, OTHERS):
     - Increment lv_skipped_rows
     - Print 'Unexpected row-level error...' for OTHERS
4. After loop:
   - Print summary: 'Printed rows: <lv_printed_rows>'
   - Print summary: 'Skipped (non-numeric/failed conversions): <lv_skipped_rows>'

Exception Handling Output:

Now take the baseline idea from the previous report and compare two years side-by-side. For the same county filter, produce a list of counties where births increased from year A to year B. Print the increase amount and a simple categorization label (e.g., HIGH/MED/LOW) based on the size of the increase. Keep it limited to the top results.

Requirements

Script purpose:
- Compare births between two years (2018 vs 2019)
- Report counties with an increase
- Categorize increases into buckets (HIGH, MED, LOW)
- Limit output for readability

Variables:
- lv_year_a → baseline year (2018)
- lv_year_b → comparison year (2019)
- lv_county_like → filter for county_of_residence (default '%')
- co_report_limit = 15 → maximum rows printed
- lv_printed_rows → counter for printed rows

Execution Logic:
1. Print header: 'County births increase from <lv_year_a> to <lv_year_b>, county like=<lv_county_like>'
2. Query logic:
   - births_a CTE:
     - Aggregate births for lv_year_a
     - Filter by county_of_residence LIKE lv_county_like
     - Only include numeric values (regex check)
   - births_b CTE:
     - Aggregate births for lv_year_b
     - Same filters as births_a
   - Main SELECT:
     - Join births_a and births_b on county_of_residence
     - Compute delta_births = births_b − births_a
     - Only include counties with positive delta_births
     - Categorize increase_bucket:
       - ≥ 1000 → HIGH
       - ≥ 200 → MED
       - Else → LOW
     - Order by delta_births DESC
3. Loop through results:
   - Increment lv_printed_rows
   - Print formatted line:
     county_of_residence | A=<births_a> | B=<births_b> | +<delta_births> | bucket=<increase_bucket>
   - Exit loop when lv_printed_rows ≥ co_report_limit
4. If lv_printed_rows = 0:
   - Print 'No counties found with an increase for the given filters/years.'

Exception Handling Output:
- NO_DATA_FOUND → 'No data found.'
- TOO_MANY_ROWS → 'Multiple rows returned.'
- OTHERS → 'Unexpected error:'
reference_answer:
DECLARE
  lv_year_a        SDOH_CDC_WONDER_NATALITY.COUNTY_NATALITY.year%TYPE := DATE '2018-01-01';
  lv_year_b        SDOH_CDC_WONDER_NATALITY.COUNTY_NATALITY.year%TYPE := DATE '2019-01-01';
  lv_county_like   VARCHAR2(100) := '%';
  co_report_limit  CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_printed_rows  PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('County births increase from ' || TO_CHAR(lv_year_a, 'YYYY') || ' to ' || TO_CHAR(lv_year_b, 'YYYY') || ', county like=' || lv_county_like);

  FOR rec IN (
    WITH births_a AS (
      SELECT cn.county_of_residence AS county_of_residence,
             SUM(TO_NUMBER(TRIM(cn.births))) AS births_num
        FROM SDOH_CDC_WONDER_NATALITY.COUNTY_NATALITY cn
       WHERE cn.year = lv_year_a
         AND cn.county_of_residence LIKE lv_county_like
         AND REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(cn.births), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
       GROUP BY cn.county_of_residence
    ),
    births_b AS (
      SELECT cn.county_of_residence AS county_of_residence,
             SUM(TO_NUMBER(TRIM(cn.births))) AS births_num
        FROM SDOH_CDC_WONDER_NATALITY.COUNTY_NATALITY cn
       WHERE cn.year = lv_year_b
         AND cn.county_of_residence LIKE lv_county_like
         AND REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(cn.births), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
       GROUP BY cn.county_of_residence
    )
    SELECT b.county_of_residence,
           a.births_num AS births_a,
           b.births_num AS births_b,
           (b.births_num - a.births_num) AS delta_births,
           CASE
             WHEN (b.births_num - a.births_num) >= 1000 THEN 'HIGH'
             WHEN (b.births_num - a.births_num) >= 200 THEN 'MED'
             ELSE 'LOW'
           END AS increase_bucket
      FROM births_a a
      INNER JOIN births_b b
        ON b.county_of_residence = a.county_of_residence
     WHERE (b.births_num - a.births_num) > 0
     ORDER BY delta_births DESC
  ) LOOP
    lv_printed_rows := lv_printed_rows + 1;
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      RPAD(rec.county_of_residence, 40) ||
      ' A=' || TO_CHAR(rec.births_a) ||
      ' B=' || TO_CHAR(rec.births_b) ||
      ' + ' || TO_CHAR(rec.delta_births) ||
      ' bucket=' || rec.increase_bucket
    );

    EXIT WHEN lv_printed_rows >= co_report_limit;
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_printed_rows = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No counties found with an increase for the given filters/years.');
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error: ' );
END;
/

Processing Rule:
Use the retrieved income_group value to determine the income category using control flow logic:
If income_group = 'Upper middle income' -> Display High Income Economy
If income_group = 'Lower middle income' -> Display Middle Income Economy
Otherwise -> Display Developing Economy
Ensure only one record is retrieved.

reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sf_country_basic
(
    p_country_code    VARCHAR2
)
RETURN VARCHAR2
IS

------------------------------------------------
-- VARIABLES
------------------------------------------------
    v_short_name      VARCHAR2(100);
    v_region          VARCHAR2(100);
    v_income_group    VARCHAR2(50);

BEGIN

------------------------------------------------
-- INPUT VALIDATION
------------------------------------------------
    IF p_country_code IS NULL THEN
        RETURN ('Country Code NULL not found');
    END IF;

------------------------------------------------
-- DATA RETRIEVAL
------------------------------------------------
    SELECT short_name,
           region,
           income_group
    INTO   v_short_name,
           v_region,
           v_income_group
    FROM   world_bank_intl_debt.country_summary
    WHERE  country_code = p_country_code
    AND    ROWNUM = 1;

------------------------------------------------
-- CONTROL FLOW
------------------------------------------------
    IF v_income_group = 'Upper middle income' THEN

        RETURN
            'Country Code: ' || p_country_code || CHR(10) ||
            'Country: ' || v_short_name || CHR(10) ||
            'Region: ' || v_region || CHR(10) ||
            'Income Group: High Income Economy';

    ELSIF v_income_group = 'Lower middle income' THEN

        RETURN
            'Country Code: ' || p_country_code || CHR(10) ||
            'Country: ' || v_short_name || CHR(10) ||
            'Region: ' || v_region || CHR(10) ||
            'Income Group: Middle Income Economy';

    ELSE

        RETURN
            'Country Code: ' || p_country_code || CHR(10) ||
            'Country: ' || v_short_name || CHR(10) ||
            'Region: ' || v_region || CHR(10) ||
            'Income Group: Developing Economy';

    END IF;

------------------------------------------------
-- EXCEPTION HANDLING
------------------------------------------------
EXCEPTION

    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RETURN 'Country Code: ' || p_country_code || ' not found';

    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RETURN 'Unexpected error occurred';

END sf_country_basic;
/

Format:

"Year: <year>"
"Period: <period>"
"CPI Value: <value>"

If the input parameter is NULL, immediately display:
"Series ID NULL not found"

Retrieve year, period, and value information associated with the specified series ID from the bls.cpi_u dataset.

Processing Rule:

If the retrieved value is NULL, display:
Series: <series_id> CPI value not available

Ensure only one record is retrieved.

If no record exists for the given series ID, catch NO_DATA_FOUND and display:
"Series ID: <series_id> not found"

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp_get_cpi_basic

question:
Design and implement a PL/SQL function that retrieves birth statistics and payment information for a county.

Requirements:
Function Name: sf_get_births_basic

Parameters:
Accept a single input parameter: p_county_fips -- represents the county FIPS identifier.

Output:
The function should return a VARCHAR2 formatted message containing the county name, payment source, and number of births.
Format:
"County FIPS: <county_name>"
"Payment : <source_of_payment>"
"Births : <births>"

If the input parameter is NULL, immediately return:
"County FIPS NULL not found"
Retrieve county_of_residence, source_of_payment, and births information associated with the specified county FIPS from the sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_payment dataset.

Processing Rule:
If the retrieved births value is NULL, return:
Birth data missing for county
Otherwise, return the formatted county birth statistics including payment information.
Ensure only one record is retrieved.

Exception Handling:
If no record exists for the given county FIPS, catch NO_DATA_FOUND and return:
"County FIPS: <county_fips> no data found"
If any unexpected runtime error occurs during execution, catch WHEN OTHERS and return:
"Unexpected error occurred"
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sf_get_births_basic
(
    p_county_fips   IN VARCHAR2
)
RETURN VARCHAR2
IS

------------------------------------------------
-- VARIABLES
------------------------------------------------
    v_county       VARCHAR2(100);
    v_payment      VARCHAR2(100);
    v_births       VARCHAR2(4000);

BEGIN

------------------------------------------------
-- INPUT VALIDATION
------------------------------------------------
    IF p_county_fips IS NULL THEN
        RETURN 'County FIPS NULL not found';
    END IF;

------------------------------------------------
-- DATA RETRIEVAL
------------------------------------------------
    SELECT county_of_residence,
           source_of_payment,
           births
    INTO   v_county,
           v_payment,
           v_births
    FROM   sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_payment
    WHERE  county_of_residence_fips = p_county_fips
    AND    ROWNUM = 1;

------------------------------------------------
-- CONTROL FLOW
------------------------------------------------
    IF v_births IS NULL THEN
        RETURN 'Birth data missing for county';
    END IF;

    RETURN 'County FIPS: ' || v_county ||CHR(10)||
           'Payment : ' || v_payment ||CHR(10)||
           'Births : ' || v_births;

------------------------------------------------
-- EXCEPTION HANDLING
------------------------------------------------
EXCEPTION

    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RETURN 'County FIPS: '||p_county_fips||' no data found';

    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RETURN 'Unexpected error occurred';

END sf_get_births_basic;
/

Requirements:

Accept a single input parameter: p_county_fips -- represents the county FIPS identifier.

Output:
The function should return a VARCHAR2 formatted message containing the county name, number of births, average mother age, average birth weight, BMI value, and BMI category.
Format:
"County FIPS: <county_name>"
"Births: <births>"
"Avg Mother Age: <age>"
"Avg Birth Weight: <weight>"
"BMI Value: <bmi>"
"BMI Category: <category>"

If the input parameter is NULL, immediately return:
"County FIPS NULL not found"
Retrieve county_of_residence, births, ave_age_of_mother, ave_birth_weight_gms, and ave_pre_pregnancy_bmi information associated with the specified county FIPS from the sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_payment dataset.
Use aggregate functions to retrieve the maximum value for each field and convert ave_pre_pregnancy_bmi to a numeric value.

Processing Rule:
If no county data exists after retrieval, return:
"County FIPS: <county_fips> no data found"
Use the retrieved BMI value to determine the health category using control flow logic:
If BMI > 30 -> HIGH BMI RISK
Otherwise -> NORMAL BMI RANGE

Exception Handling:
If any unexpected runtime error occurs during execution, catch WHEN OTHERS and return:
"Unexpected error occurred"
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sf_get_births_health_info
(
    p_county_fips    IN VARCHAR2
)
RETURN VARCHAR2
IS

------------------------------------------------
-- VARIABLES
------------------------------------------------
    v_county       VARCHAR2(100);
    v_births       VARCHAR2(4000);
    v_age          VARCHAR2(4000);
    v_weight       VARCHAR2(4000);
    v_bmi          NUMBER;
    v_health_cat   VARCHAR2(100);

BEGIN

------------------------------------------------
-- INPUT VALIDATION
------------------------------------------------
    IF p_county_fips IS NULL THEN
        RETURN 'County FIPS NULL not found';
    END IF;

------------------------------------------------
-- DATA RETRIEVAL
------------------------------------------------
    SELECT MAX(county_of_residence),
           MAX(births),
           MAX(ave_age_of_mother),
           MAX(ave_birth_weight_gms),
           MAX(TO_NUMBER(ave_pre_pregnancy_bmi))
    INTO   v_county,
           v_births,
           v_age,
           v_weight,
           v_bmi
    FROM   sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_payment
    WHERE  county_of_residence_fips = p_county_fips;

------------------------------------------------
-- ROOT CAUSE CHECK
------------------------------------------------
    IF v_county IS NULL THEN
        RETURN 'County FIPS: ' || p_county_fips || ' no data found';
    END IF;

------------------------------------------------
-- CONTROL FLOW
------------------------------------------------
    IF v_bmi > 30 THEN
        v_health_cat := 'HIGH BMI RISK';
    ELSE
        v_health_cat := 'NORMAL BMI RANGE';
    END IF;

------------------------------------------------
-- OUTPUT
------------------------------------------------
    RETURN 'County FIPS: ' || v_county || CHR(10) ||
           'Births: ' || v_births || CHR(10) ||
           'Avg Mother Age: ' || v_age || CHR(10) ||
           'Avg Birth Weight: ' || v_weight || CHR(10) ||
           'BMI Value: ' || v_bmi || CHR(10) ||
           'BMI Category: ' || v_health_cat;

------------------------------------------------
-- EXCEPTION
------------------------------------------------
EXCEPTION

    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RETURN 'Unexpected error occurred';

END sf_get_births_health_info;
/

Output:
The function should return a VARCHAR2 formatted message containing the county FIPS, total births, average birth weight, and average prenatal weeks.
Format:
"County FIPS : <county_fips>"
"Total Births : <total_births>"
"Avg Birth Weight : <avg_birth_weight>"
"Avg Prenatal Weeks : <avg_prenatal_weeks>"

If the input parameter is NULL, immediately return:
"County FIPS NULL not found"
Retrieve aggregated birth statistics associated with the specified county FIPS from the sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_payment dataset.

Data Retrieval Rules:
Calculate the following values using aggregate functions:
SUM of births -> Total Births
AVG of ave_birth_weight_gms -> Average Birth Weight
AVG of ave_number_of_prenatal_wks -> Average Prenatal Weeks
Convert the retrieved values to numeric where required.

Processing Rule:
If the retrieved total births value is NULL, return:
"County FIPS: <county_fips> no data found"
Otherwise, return the formatted county birth statistics summary.

Exception Handling:
If any unexpected runtime error occurs during execution, catch WHEN OTHERS and return:
"Unexpected error occurred"
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sf_get_county_births_summary
(
    p_county_fips   IN VARCHAR2
)
RETURN VARCHAR2
IS

------------------------------------------------
-- VARIABLES
------------------------------------------------
    v_total_births      NUMBER;
    v_avg_weight        NUMBER;
    v_avg_prenatal      NUMBER;

BEGIN

------------------------------------------------
-- INPUT VALIDATION
------------------------------------------------
    IF p_county_fips IS NULL THEN
        RETURN 'County FIPS NULL not found';
    END IF;

------------------------------------------------
-- DATA RETRIEVAL
------------------------------------------------
    SELECT SUM(TO_NUMBER(births)),
           AVG(TO_NUMBER(ave_birth_weight_gms)),
           AVG(TO_NUMBER(ave_number_of_prenatal_wks))
    INTO   v_total_births,
           v_avg_weight,
           v_avg_prenatal
    FROM   sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_payment
    WHERE  county_of_residence_fips = p_county_fips;

------------------------------------------------
-- CONTROL FLOW
------------------------------------------------
    IF v_total_births IS NULL THEN
        RETURN 'County FIPS: '||p_county_fips||' no data found';
    END IF;

    RETURN 'County FIPS : ' || p_county_fips ||CHR(10)||
           'Total Births : ' || v_total_births ||CHR(10)||
           'Avg Birth Weight : ' || v_avg_weight ||CHR(10)||
           'Avg Prenatal Weeks : ' || v_avg_prenatal;

------------------------------------------------
-- EXCEPTION HANDLING
------------------------------------------------
EXCEPTION

    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RETURN 'Unexpected error occurred';

END sf_get_county_births_summary;
/

question:
Build a small operational report for the pizza team: list up to 15 recent cleaned customer orders and show whether each order has any extras or exclusions. Keep the output readable and handle unexpected issues gracefully.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: Anonymous Block
Parameters: None
Output: DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Recent cleaned orders (max rows = ' || co_report_limit || '):');
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Order ' || rec.order_id || ' | customer ' || rec.customer_id || ' | pizza ' || rec.pizza_id || ' | has_exclusions=' || rec.has_exclusions || ' | has_extras=' || rec.has_extras);
Exception Handling: WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Recent cleaned orders (max rows = ' || co_report_limit || '):');

  FOR rec IN (
    SELECT
      cco.order_id,
      cco.customer_id,
      cco.pizza_id,
      CASE
        WHEN cco.exclusions IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(cco.exclusions)) IN ('', 'null') THEN 'N'
        ELSE 'Y'
      END AS has_exclusions,
      CASE
        WHEN cco.extras IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(cco.extras)) IN ('', 'null') THEN 'N'
        ELSE 'Y'
      END AS has_extras
    FROM MODERN_DATA.PIZZA_CLEAN_CUSTOMER_ORDERS cco
    WHERE cco.order_time IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY cco.order_time DESC
    FETCH FIRST co_report_limit ROWS ONLY
  ) LOOP
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'Order ' || rec.order_id ||
      ' | customer ' || rec.customer_id ||
      ' | pizza ' || rec.pizza_id ||
      ' | has_exclusions=' || rec.has_exclusions ||
      ' | has_extras=' || rec.has_extras
    );
  END LOOP;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;
/

DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Cancellation summary (max rows = ' || co_report_limit || '):');

  FOR rec IN (

        WHEN ro.cancellation IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(ro.cancellation)) IN ('', 'null') THEN 'not cancelled'

      NVL(ro.cancellation, '(NULL)')
    ORDER BY order_cnt DESC
    FETCH FIRST co_report_limit ROWS ONLY

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'category=' || rec.cancel_category ||
      ' | raw_reason=' || rec.raw_reason ||
      ' | orders=' || rec.order_cnt

DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_country_name CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.AGE_SPECIFIC_FERTILITY_RATES.country_name%TYPE := 'India';
  lv_latest_year  CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.AGE_SPECIFIC_FERTILITY_RATES.year%TYPE;

  CURSOR c_fert(p_country CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.AGE_SPECIFIC_FERTILITY_RATES.country_name%TYPE,
                p_latest_year CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.AGE_SPECIFIC_FERTILITY_RATES.year%TYPE) IS
    SELECT a.year,
           CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.total_fertility_rate, '^\s*[-+]?\d+(\.\d+)?\s*$')
                THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(a.total_fertility_rate))
                ELSE NULL
           END AS tfr,
           CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.fertility_rate_15_19, '^\s*[-+]?\d+(\.\d+)?\s*$')
                THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(a.fertility_rate_15_19))
                ELSE NULL
           END AS fr_15_19,
           CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.fertility_rate_20_24, '^\s*[-+]?\d+(\.\d+)?\s*$')
                THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(a.fertility_rate_20_24))
                ELSE NULL
           END AS fr_20_24,
           CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.fertility_rate_25_29, '^\s*[-+]?\d+(\.\d+)?\s*$')
                THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(a.fertility_rate_25_29))
                ELSE NULL
           END AS fr_25_29,
           CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.fertility_rate_30_34, '^\s*[-+]?\d+(\.\d+)?\s*$')
                THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(a.fertility_rate_30_34))
                ELSE NULL
           END AS fr_30_34,
           CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.fertility_rate_35_39, '^\s*[-+]?\d+(\.\d+)?\s*$')
                THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(a.fertility_rate_35_39))
                ELSE NULL
           END AS fr_35_39,
           CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.fertility_rate_40_44, '^\s*[-+]?\d+(\.\d+)?\s*$')
                THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(a.fertility_rate_40_44))
                ELSE NULL
           END AS fr_40_44,
           CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.fertility_rate_45_49, '^\s*[-+]?\d+(\.\d+)?\s*$')
                THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(a.fertility_rate_45_49))
                ELSE NULL
           END AS fr_45_49
      FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.AGE_SPECIFIC_FERTILITY_RATES a
     WHERE a.country_name = p_country
       AND a.year <= p_latest_year
     ORDER BY a.year DESC;

  lv_rows_printed PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  -- Latest year for this country
  SELECT MAX(a.year)
    INTO lv_latest_year
    FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.AGE_SPECIFIC_FERTILITY_RATES a
   WHERE a.country_name = lv_country_name;

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Fertility report for: ' || lv_country_name || ' (latest year=' || lv_latest_year || ')');

  FOR rec IN c_fert(lv_country_name, lv_latest_year) LOOP
    lv_rows_printed := lv_rows_printed + 1;
    EXIT WHEN lv_rows_printed > co_report_limit;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'YEAR=' || rec.year ||
      ' TFR=' || TO_CHAR(rec.tfr) ||
      ' 15_19=' || TO_CHAR(rec.fr_15_19) ||
      ' 20_24=' || TO_CHAR(rec.fr_20_24) ||
      ' 25_29=' || TO_CHAR(rec.fr_25_29) ||
      ' 30_34=' || TO_CHAR(rec.fr_30_34) ||
      ' 35_39=' || TO_CHAR(rec.fr_35_39) ||
      ' 40_44=' || TO_CHAR(rec.fr_40_44) ||
      ' 45_49=' || TO_CHAR(rec.fr_45_49)
    );
  END LOOP;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;
/

reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE report_country_fertility_birth(
  p_country_name IN CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.AGE_SPECIFIC_FERTILITY_RATES.country_name%TYPE,
  p_year_from    IN CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.AGE_SPECIFIC_FERTILITY_RATES.year%TYPE,
  p_year_to      IN CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.AGE_SPECIFIC_FERTILITY_RATES.year%TYPE
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  CURSOR c_metrics IS
    WITH fert AS (
      SELECT a.country_name,
             a.year,
             CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.total_fertility_rate, '^\s*[-+]?\d+(\.\d+)?\s*$')
                  THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(a.total_fertility_rate))
                  ELSE NULL
             END AS tfr
        FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.AGE_SPECIFIC_FERTILITY_RATES a
       WHERE a.country_name = p_country_name
         AND a.year BETWEEN p_year_from AND p_year_to
    ),
    births AS (
      SELECT b.country_name,
             b.year,
             CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(b.crude_birth_rate, '^\s*[-+]?\d+(\.\d+)?\s*$')
                  THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(b.crude_birth_rate))
                  ELSE NULL
             END AS cbr
        FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.BIRTH_DEATH_GROWTH_RATES b
       WHERE b.country_name = p_country_name
         AND b.year BETWEEN p_year_from AND p_year_to
    ),
    full_years AS (
      SELECT f.year
        FROM fert f
      UNION
      SELECT br.year
        FROM births br
    )
    SELECT y.year,
           (SELECT f.tfr FROM fert f WHERE f.year = y.year) AS tfr,
           (SELECT br.cbr FROM births br WHERE br.year = y.year) AS cbr
      FROM full_years y
     ORDER BY y.year DESC;

  lv_rows_printed PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Country metrics: ' || p_country_name || ' years ' || p_year_from || '-' || p_year_to);

  FOR rec IN c_metrics LOOP
    lv_rows_printed := lv_rows_printed + 1;
    EXIT WHEN lv_rows_printed > co_report_limit;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('YEAR=' || rec.year || ' TFR=' || TO_CHAR(rec.tfr) || ' CRUDE_BIRTH_RATE=' || TO_CHAR(rec.cbr));
  END LOOP;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END report_country_fertility_birth;
/

question:
We’re building a quick operational report for SF Bikeshare. Pull the latest status snapshot time in the data, then list up to 15 stations (at that snapshot) with the highest bikes available. Include station id, station name, landmark, bikes available, docks available, and the snapshot timestamp. Make sure the block prints a header plus one line per station, and that it handles cases where there is no status data.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: Anonymous Block.
Parameters: None.
Output:
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Latest status snapshot: ' || TO_CHAR(lv_snapshot_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Top stations by bikes available (max ' || co_report_limit || ' rows):')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Station ' || rec.station_id || ' | ' || rec.station_name || ' | ' || rec.landmark || ' | bikes=' || rec.bikes_available || ' | docks=' || rec.docks_available || ' | time=' || TO_CHAR(rec.snapshot_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_snapshot_time SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATUS.time%TYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT MAX(bs.time)
    INTO lv_snapshot_time
    FROM SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATUS bs;

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Latest status snapshot: ' || TO_CHAR(lv_snapshot_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'));
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Top stations by bikes available (max ' || co_report_limit || ' rows):');

  FOR rec IN (
    SELECT x.station_id,
           x.station_name,
           x.landmark,
           x.bikes_available,
           x.docks_available,
           x.snapshot_time
      FROM (
            SELECT st.station_id AS station_id,
                   st.name AS station_name,
                   st.landmark AS landmark,
                   TO_NUMBER(bs.bikes_available) AS bikes_available,
                   TO_NUMBER(bs.docks_available) AS docks_available,
                   bs.time AS snapshot_time
              FROM SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATUS bs
              INNER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATIONS st
                ON st.station_id = bs.station_id
             WHERE bs.time = lv_snapshot_time
             ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(bs.bikes_available) DESC, st.name ASC
           ) x
     WHERE ROWNUM <= co_report_limit
  ) LOOP
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'Station ' || rec.station_id || ' | ' || rec.station_name || ' | ' || rec.landmark ||
      ' | bikes=' || rec.bikes_available || ' | docks=' || rec.docks_available ||
      ' | time=' || TO_CHAR(rec.snapshot_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
    );
  END LOOP;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;

Include region and station name in the output so the team can quickly find the kiosk. This is an investigation routine, so be verbose.

Requirements:

Parameters:
None
Output:
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Suspicious station status rows (max rows scanned = ' || co_scan_limit || ')')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Station ' || lr.station_id || ' (' || lr.station_name || '), region=' || lr.region_name || ', bikes_raw=' || lr.bikes_raw || ', docks_raw=' || lr.docks_raw || ', issue=' || lr.issue)
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No suspicious rows found in the scanned set.')
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE diagnose_suspicious_station_status IS
  co_scan_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Keep diagnostic output manageable

  lv_found VARCHAR2(1) := 'N';
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Suspicious station status rows (max rows scanned = ' || co_scan_limit || ')');

  FOR lr IN (
    WITH scan_set AS (
      SELECT *
        FROM (
          SELECT ss.station_id,
                 si.name AS station_name,
                 r.name AS region_name,
                 ss.num_bikes_available AS bikes_raw,
                 ss.num_docks_available AS docks_raw,
                 CASE
                   WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(ss.num_bikes_available, ''), '^[-]?[0-9]+$') THEN 'Bikes not numeric'
                   WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(ss.num_docks_available, ''), '^[-]?[0-9]+$') THEN 'Docks not numeric'
                   WHEN TO_NUMBER(ss.num_bikes_available) < 0 THEN 'Bikes negative'
                   WHEN TO_NUMBER(ss.num_docks_available) < 0 THEN 'Docks negative'
                   ELSE NULL
                 END AS issue
            FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_STATUS ss
            INNER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si
              ON si.station_id = ss.station_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_REGIONS r
              ON r.region_id = si.region_id
           ORDER BY ss.station_id
        )
       WHERE ROWNUM <= co_scan_limit
    )
    SELECT s.station_id,
           s.station_name,
           s.region_name,
           s.bikes_raw,
           s.docks_raw,
           s.issue
      FROM scan_set s
     WHERE s.issue IS NOT NULL
  ) LOOP
    lv_found := 'Y';
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Station ' || lr.station_id || ' (' || lr.station_name || '), region=' || lr.region_name || ', bikes_raw=' || lr.bikes_raw || ', docks_raw=' || lr.docks_raw || ', issue=' || lr.issue);
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_found = 'N' THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No suspicious rows found in the scanned set.');
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END diagnose_suspicious_station_status;
/

The procedure should check for region-level data issues that could mislead the health snapshot: stations with missing or invalid status rows, stations with status flags not equal to '0' or '1', and stations where bikes/docks cannot be treated as non-negative numbers. Print a summarized finding per issue type, and for each issue print up to 15 example stations including station name and region name. Use clear branching so that when there are no issues found, it prints a final clean-bill-of-health line.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: validate_region_health_inputs
Parameters:
p_region_name IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_REGIONS.name%TYPE
Output:
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Validation for region: ' || lv_region_name)
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Issue: stations missing status rows = ' || lv_missing_status)
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Example missing status: ' || lr.station_id || ' - ' || lr.station_name || ', region=' || lr.region_name)
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Issue: stations with invalid flag values = ' || lv_invalid_flags)
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Example invalid flags: ' || lr2.station_id || ' - ' || lr2.station_name || ', region=' || lr2.region_name || ', installed=' || lr2.is_installed || ', renting=' || lr2.is_renting || ', returning=' || lr2.is_returning)
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Issue: stations with invalid availability values = ' || lv_invalid_avail)
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Example invalid availability: ' || lr3.station_id || ' - ' || lr3.station_name || ', region=' || lr3.region_name || ', bikes_raw=' || lr3.bikes_raw || ', docks_raw=' || lr3.docks_raw)
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Validation passed: no issues found for this region.')
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE validate_region_health_inputs(
  p_region_name IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_REGIONS.name%TYPE
) IS
  co_example_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Cap examples to keep output readable

  lv_region_id        SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_REGIONS.region_id%TYPE;
  lv_region_name      SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_REGIONS.name%TYPE;
  lv_missing_status   NUMBER := 0;
  lv_invalid_flags    NUMBER := 0;
  lv_invalid_avail    NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
  SELECT r.region_id, r.name
    INTO lv_region_id, lv_region_name
    FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_REGIONS r
   WHERE r.name = p_region_name;

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Validation for region: ' || lv_region_name);

  -- 1) Missing status rows
  SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO lv_missing_status
    FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si
    LEFT OUTER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_STATUS ss
      ON ss.station_id = si.station_id
   WHERE si.region_id = lv_region_id
     AND ss.station_id IS NULL;

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Issue: stations missing status rows = ' || lv_missing_status);

  IF lv_missing_status > 0 THEN
    FOR lr IN (
      SELECT *
        FROM (
          SELECT si.station_id,
                 si.name AS station_name,
                 lv_region_name AS region_name
            FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si
            LEFT OUTER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_STATUS ss
              ON ss.station_id = si.station_id
           WHERE si.region_id = lv_region_id
             AND ss.station_id IS NULL
           ORDER BY si.name
        )
       WHERE ROWNUM <= co_example_limit
    ) LOOP
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Example missing status: ' || lr.station_id || ' - ' || lr.station_name || ', region=' || lr.region_name);
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  -- 2) Invalid flag values (not '0' or '1')
  SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO lv_invalid_flags
    FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si
    INNER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_STATUS ss
      ON ss.station_id = si.station_id
   WHERE si.region_id = lv_region_id
     AND (ss.is_installed NOT IN ('0','1')
          OR ss.is_renting NOT IN ('0','1')
          OR ss.is_returning NOT IN ('0','1'));

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Issue: stations with invalid flag values = ' || lv_invalid_flags);

  IF lv_invalid_flags > 0 THEN
    FOR lr2 IN (
      SELECT *
        FROM (
          SELECT si.station_id,
                 si.name AS station_name,
                 lv_region_name AS region_name,
                 ss.is_installed,
                 ss.is_renting,
                 ss.is_returning
            FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si
            INNER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_STATUS ss
              ON ss.station_id = si.station_id
           WHERE si.region_id = lv_region_id
             AND (ss.is_installed NOT IN ('0','1')
                  OR ss.is_renting NOT IN ('0','1')
                  OR ss.is_returning NOT IN ('0','1'))
           ORDER BY si.name
        )
       WHERE ROWNUM <= co_example_limit
    ) LOOP
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Example invalid flags: ' || lr2.station_id || ' - ' || lr2.station_name || ', region=' || lr2.region_name || ', installed=' || lr2.is_installed || ', renting=' || lr2.is_renting || ', returning=' || lr2.is_returning);
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  -- 3) Invalid availability (non-numeric or negative)
  SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO lv_invalid_avail
    FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si
    INNER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_STATUS ss
      ON ss.station_id = si.station_id
   WHERE si.region_id = lv_region_id
     AND (
       NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(ss.num_bikes_available, ''), '^[0-9]+$')
       OR NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(ss.num_docks_available, ''), '^[0-9]+$')
       OR TO_NUMBER(ss.num_bikes_available) < 0
       OR TO_NUMBER(ss.num_docks_available) < 0
     );

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Issue: stations with invalid availability values = ' || lv_invalid_avail);

  IF lv_invalid_avail > 0 THEN
    FOR lr3 IN (
      SELECT *
        FROM (
          SELECT si.station_id,
                 si.name AS station_name,
                 lv_region_name AS region_name,
                 ss.num_bikes_available AS bikes_raw,
                 ss.num_docks_available AS docks_raw
            FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si
            INNER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_STATUS ss
              ON ss.station_id = si.station_id
           WHERE si.region_id = lv_region_id
             AND (
               NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(ss.num_bikes_available, ''), '^[0-9]+$')
               OR NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(ss.num_docks_available, ''), '^[0-9]+$')
               OR TO_NUMBER(ss.num_bikes_available) < 0
               OR TO_NUMBER(ss.num_docks_available) < 0
             )
           ORDER BY si.name
        )
       WHERE ROWNUM <= co_example_limit
    ) LOOP
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Example invalid availability: ' || lr3.station_id || ' - ' || lr3.station_name || ', region=' || lr3.region_name || ', bikes_raw=' || lr3.bikes_raw || ', docks_raw=' || lr3.docks_raw);
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  IF lv_missing_status = 0 AND lv_invalid_flags = 0 AND lv_invalid_avail = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Validation passed: no issues found for this region.');
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END validate_region_health_inputs;
/

Build a small on-call style report for Pizza Runner operations: list up to 15 most recent customer orders and show whether each order was delivered or cancelled, plus any cancellation reason. If the cancellation reason is missing, print it as 'N/A'.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: Anonymous Block.
Parameters: None.
Output:
'Runner Ops Report (most recent first), max rows = ' || co_report_limit
'Order ' || rec.order_id || ': customer_id=' || rec.customer_id || ', runner_id=' || NVL(TO_CHAR(rec.runner_id), 'N/A') || ', status=' || rec.status || ', cancellation=' || rec.cancellation_text
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Runner Ops Report (most recent first), max rows = ' || co_report_limit);

  FOR rec IN (
    SELECT
      cco.order_id,
      cco.customer_id,
      cro.runner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN cro.order_id IS NULL THEN 'UNASSIGNED'
        WHEN cro.cancellation IS NULL OR TRIM(cro.cancellation) = '' THEN 'DELIVERED'
        ELSE 'CANCELLED'
      END AS status,
      NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(cro.cancellation), ''), 'N/A') AS cancellation_text
    FROM MODERN_DATA.PIZZA_CLEAN_CUSTOMER_ORDERS cco
    LEFT JOIN MODERN_DATA.PIZZA_CLEAN_RUNNER_ORDERS cro
      ON cro.order_id = cco.order_id
    ORDER BY cco.order_time DESC
    FETCH FIRST co_report_limit ROWS ONLY
  ) LOOP
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'Order ' || rec.order_id ||
      ': customer_id=' || rec.customer_id ||
      ', runner_id=' || NVL(TO_CHAR(rec.runner_id), 'N/A') ||
      ', status=' || rec.status ||
      ', cancellation=' || rec.cancellation_text
    );
  END LOOP;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;
/

Finalize the workflow by producing a “data quality dashboard” for a year that ranks (top 15) counties by the rate of births with a checked congenital abnormality. Use the congenital abnormalities table for the checked counts and the base county natality table for total births. For each ranked county, show total births, checked births, and the percentage checked. Handle the case where totals are zero. Use explicit cursors and print the ranked results.

Requirements:

Parameters:

Output:
'Congenital abnormality checked rate for year=' || p_year
RPAD('County FIPS', 12) || ' | ' || LPAD('Total', 10) || ' | ' || LPAD('Checked', 10) || ' | ' || LPAD('%Checked', 10)
RPAD('-', 12, '-') || '-+-' || LPAD('-', 10, '-') || '-+-' || LPAD('-', 10, '-') || '-+-' || LPAD('-', 10, '-')
RPAD(rec.county_of_residence_fips, 12) || ' | ' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.total_births), 10) || ' | ' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.checked_births), 10) || ' | ' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.pct_checked, 'FM990D00'), 10)

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE top_spender_customer(
  p_min_total IN ORACLE_SQL.ORDERLINES.amount%TYPE
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Retained to align with reporting standards

  lv_customer_id   ORACLE_SQL.CUSTOMERS.id%TYPE;
  lv_customer_name ORACLE_SQL.CUSTOMERS.name%TYPE;
  lv_total_amt     ORACLE_SQL.ORDERLINES.amount%TYPE;
  lv_max_total     ORACLE_SQL.ORDERLINES.amount%TYPE;
  lv_cnt           PLS_INTEGER;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Top spender analysis (min total = ' || TO_CHAR(p_min_total) || ')');

  SELECT MAX(total_amt)
    INTO lv_max_total
    FROM (
      SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
             c.name AS customer_name,
             SUM(ol.amount) AS total_amt
        FROM ORACLE_SQL.CUSTOMERS c
        INNER JOIN ORACLE_SQL.ORDERS o
          ON o.customer_id = c.id
        INNER JOIN ORACLE_SQL.ORDERLINES ol
          ON ol.order_id = o.id
       GROUP BY c.id, c.name
      HAVING SUM(ol.amount) >= p_min_total
    );

  SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO lv_cnt
    FROM (
      SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
             c.name AS customer_name,
             SUM(ol.amount) AS total_amt
        FROM ORACLE_SQL.CUSTOMERS c
        INNER JOIN ORACLE_SQL.ORDERS o
          ON o.customer_id = c.id
        INNER JOIN ORACLE_SQL.ORDERLINES ol
          ON ol.order_id = o.id
       GROUP BY c.id, c.name
      HAVING SUM(ol.amount) >= p_min_total
    )
   WHERE total_amt = lv_max_total;

  IF lv_cnt > 1 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Data quality issue: multiple top spenders.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  SELECT s.customer_id,
         s.customer_name,
         s.total_amt
    INTO lv_customer_id,
         lv_customer_name,
         lv_total_amt
    FROM (
      SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
             c.name AS customer_name,
             SUM(ol.amount) AS total_amt
        FROM ORACLE_SQL.CUSTOMERS c
        INNER JOIN ORACLE_SQL.ORDERS o
          ON o.customer_id = c.id
        INNER JOIN ORACLE_SQL.ORDERLINES ol
          ON ol.order_id = o.id
       GROUP BY c.id, c.name
      HAVING SUM(ol.amount) >= p_min_total
    ) s
   WHERE s.total_amt = lv_max_total;

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
    'Top spender: CUSTOMER_ID=' || lv_customer_id ||
    ' | NAME=' || lv_customer_name ||
    ' | TOTAL_AMT=' || TO_CHAR(lv_total_amt)
  );

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No qualifying customer found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END top_spender_customer;
/
