reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE audit_region_trip_station_quality(
  p_region_id IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_REGIONS.region_id%TYPE,
  p_start_ts  IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.start_date%TYPE,
  p_end_ts    IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.end_date%TYPE
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit example output

  lv_region_name SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_REGIONS.name%TYPE;
  lv_trips_scanned NUMBER := 0;
  lv_bad_trips NUMBER := 0;
  lv_rows_printed PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
    'Audit region_id=' || p_region_id ||
    ' from ' || TO_CHAR(p_start_ts, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ||
    ' to ' || TO_CHAR(p_end_ts, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
  );

  -- Guard against invalid time windows.
  IF p_start_ts IS NOT NULL AND p_end_ts IS NOT NULL AND p_end_ts < p_start_ts THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid window: end timestamp is earlier than start timestamp.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Validate region exists.
  SELECT r.name
    INTO lv_region_name
    FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_REGIONS r
   WHERE r.region_id = p_region_id;

  -- Count trips scoped to region by start station's region.
  SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO lv_trips_scanned
    FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS t
    JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si_start
      ON si_start.station_id = t.start_station_id
   WHERE si_start.region_id = p_region_id
     AND t.start_date >= p_start_ts
     AND t.end_date <= p_end_ts;

  IF lv_trips_scanned = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No trips found in the given window.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Count trips where either start or end station id lacks a station_info row.
  SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO lv_bad_trips
    FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS t
    JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si_start
      ON si_start.station_id = t.start_station_id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si_end
      ON si_end.station_id = t.end_station_id
   WHERE si_start.region_id = p_region_id
     AND t.start_date >= p_start_ts
     AND t.end_date <= p_end_ts
     AND (si_start.station_id IS NULL OR si_end.station_id IS NULL);

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Trips scanned=' || lv_trips_scanned || ' | Trips with missing station info=' || lv_bad_trips);

  -- Print up to 15 example station ids that are missing.
  FOR rec IN (
    WITH scoped_trips AS (
      SELECT t.start_station_id,
             t.end_station_id
        FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS t
        JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si_start
          ON si_start.station_id = t.start_station_id
       WHERE si_start.region_id = p_region_id
         AND t.start_date >= p_start_ts
         AND t.end_date <= p_end_ts
    )
    SELECT which_side,
           station_id
      FROM (
        SELECT 'END' AS which_side,
               st.end_station_id AS station_id
          FROM scoped_trips st
         WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1
                   FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si
                  WHERE si.station_id = st.end_station_id
               )
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'START' AS which_side,
               st.start_station_id AS station_id
          FROM scoped_trips st
         WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1
                   FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si
                  WHERE si.station_id = st.start_station_id
               )
      )
     GROUP BY which_side, station_id
     ORDER BY which_side, station_id
  ) LOOP
    EXIT WHEN lv_rows_printed >= co_report_limit;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Examples (max ' || co_report_limit || '): ' || rec.which_side || ' station_id=' || rec.station_id);
    lv_rows_printed := lv_rows_printed + 1;
  END LOOP;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Region not found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END audit_region_trip_station_quality;
/

Finally, tie everything together with a single orchestrator procedure that runs the snapshot, trend, and DQ check for an operations run. Inputs are country name and year; the trend range should be year-2 through year. Print a clear start/end banner and only proceed to the trend report if the DQ overall status is PASS.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: ops_country_year_run
Parameters:
p_country_name IN CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.COUNTRY_NAMES_AREA.country_name%TYPE
p_year IN CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.MIDYEAR_POPULATION.year%TYPE
Output:
'OPS RUN START: country=' || p_country_name || ', year=' || p_year
'OPS: DQ PASS, running trend.'
'OPS: DQ FAIL, skipping trend.'
'OPS RUN END'
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN: 'Bad numeric value.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
tests:
SET SERVEROUTPUT ON;
DECLARE
  v_country_name CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.COUNTRY_NAMES_AREA.country_name%TYPE;
  v_year         CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.MIDYEAR_POPULATION.year%TYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT c.country_name, m.year
    INTO v_country_name, v_year
    FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.COUNTRY_NAMES_AREA c
    JOIN CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.MIDYEAR_POPULATION m
      ON m.country_code = c.country_code
    JOIN CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.AGE_SPECIFIC_FERTILITY_RATES f
      ON f.country_code = c.country_code
     AND f.year = m.year
   WHERE (NOT REGEXP_LIKE(m.midyear_population, '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
          OR NOT REGEXP_LIKE(f.total_fertility_rate, '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'))
     AND (SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_INTERNATIONAL.COUNTRY_NAMES_AREA c2
           WHERE UPPER(c2.country_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(c.country_name)) || '%') = 1
   FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY;

  ops_country_year_run(v_country_name, v_year);
EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No non-numeric population or TFR rows found to trigger VALUE_ERROR.');
END;
/

reference_answer:
SET SERVEROUTPUT ON;
DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT NUMBER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability
  lv_rows_printed NUMBER := 0;

  CURSOR c_card_summary IS
    SELECT ranked_cards.card_id,
           ranked_cards.event_name,
           ranked_cards.location_name,
           ranked_cards.promotion_name,
           ranked_cards.event_date,
           ranked_cards.match_count,
           ranked_cards.title_change_count
      FROM (
            SELECT c.id AS card_id,
                   e.name AS event_name,
                   l.name AS location_name,
                   p.name AS promotion_name,
                   c.event_date AS event_date,
                   COUNT(m.id) AS match_count,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN m.title_change = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS title_change_count
              FROM WWE.CARDS c
              INNER JOIN WWE.EVENTS e
                ON e.id = c.event_id
              LEFT OUTER JOIN WWE.LOCATIONS l
                ON l.id = c.location_id
              LEFT OUTER JOIN WWE.PROMOTIONS p
                ON p.id = c.promotion_id
              LEFT OUTER JOIN WWE.MATCHES m
                ON m.card_id = c.id
             GROUP BY c.id,
                      e.name,
                      l.name,
                      p.name,
                      c.event_date
             ORDER BY COUNT(m.id) DESC,
                      c.id ASC
           ) ranked_cards
     WHERE ROWNUM <= co_report_limit;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('WWE card activity snapshot (top cards by match count):');

  FOR rec IN c_card_summary LOOP
    lv_rows_printed := lv_rows_printed + 1;
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Card ' || rec.card_id || ': ' || rec.event_name || ' | ' || rec.location_name || ' | ' || rec.promotion_name || ' | date=' || rec.event_date || ' | matches=' || rec.match_count || ' | title changes=' || rec.title_change_count);

    IF rec.title_change_count > 0 THEN
      NULL;
    ELSE
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Card ' || rec.card_id || ' has no title changes in the stored match data.');
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows_printed = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No cards were found for the snapshot.');
  END IF;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE report_wwe_card_matches(
  p_card_id IN WWE.CARDS.ID%TYPE
) IS
  co_match_limit CONSTANT NUMBER := 15; -- Limit detailed match output for readability
  lv_event_name WWE.EVENTS.NAME%TYPE;
  lv_location_name WWE.LOCATIONS.NAME%TYPE;
  lv_promotion_name WWE.PROMOTIONS.NAME%TYPE;
  lv_event_date WWE.CARDS.EVENT_DATE%TYPE;
  lv_match_count NUMBER := 0;
  lv_probe_card_id WWE.CARDS.ID%TYPE;

  CURSOR c_card_matches(cp_card_id WWE.MATCHES.CARD_ID%TYPE) IS
    SELECT limited_matches.match_id,
           limited_matches.winner_name,
           limited_matches.loser_name,
           limited_matches.match_type_name,
           limited_matches.title_name,
           limited_matches.title_id,
           limited_matches.duration,
           limited_matches.win_type
      FROM (
            SELECT m.id AS match_id,
                   NVL(winner_w.name, m.winner_id) AS winner_name,
                   NVL(loser_w.name, m.loser_id) AS loser_name,
                   NVL(mt.name, m.match_type_id) AS match_type_name,
                   NVL(b.name, m.title_id) AS title_name,
                   m.title_id AS title_id,
                   m.duration AS duration,
                   m.win_type AS win_type
              FROM WWE.MATCHES m
              LEFT OUTER JOIN WWE.WRESTLERS winner_w
                ON TO_CHAR(winner_w.id) = m.winner_id
              LEFT OUTER JOIN WWE.WRESTLERS loser_w
                ON TO_CHAR(loser_w.id) = m.loser_id
              LEFT OUTER JOIN WWE.MATCH_TYPES mt
                ON TO_CHAR(mt.id) = m.match_type_id
              LEFT OUTER JOIN WWE.BELTS b
                ON TO_CHAR(b.id) = m.title_id
             WHERE m.card_id = cp_card_id
             ORDER BY m.id ASC
           ) limited_matches
     WHERE ROWNUM <= co_match_limit;
BEGIN
  IF p_card_id IS NULL THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Card id is required.');
  ELSIF p_card_id = 0 THEN
    SELECT duplicate_probe.id
      INTO lv_probe_card_id
      FROM (
            SELECT c.id AS id FROM WWE.CARDS c WHERE ROWNUM = 1
            UNION ALL
            SELECT c.id AS id FROM WWE.CARDS c WHERE ROWNUM = 1
           ) duplicate_probe;
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Duplicate-card sanity probe completed.');
  ELSE
    SELECT e.name,
           l.name,
           p.name,
           c.event_date
      INTO lv_event_name,
           lv_location_name,
           lv_promotion_name,
           lv_event_date
      FROM WWE.CARDS c
      INNER JOIN WWE.EVENTS e
        ON e.id = c.event_id
      LEFT OUTER JOIN WWE.LOCATIONS l
        ON l.id = c.location_id
      LEFT OUTER JOIN WWE.PROMOTIONS p
        ON p.id = c.promotion_id
     WHERE c.id = p_card_id;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Card ' || p_card_id || ': ' || lv_event_name || ' at ' || lv_location_name || ' on ' || lv_event_date || ' (' || lv_promotion_name || ')');

    FOR rec IN c_card_matches(p_card_id) LOOP
      lv_match_count := lv_match_count + 1;

      IF rec.title_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Match ' || rec.match_id || ': winner=' || rec.winner_name || ', loser=' || rec.loser_name || ', type=' || rec.match_type_name || ', title=' || rec.title_name || ', duration=' || rec.duration || ', result=' || rec.win_type);
      ELSE
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Match ' || rec.match_id || ': winner=' || rec.winner_name || ', loser=' || rec.loser_name || ', type=' || rec.match_type_name || ', no title recorded, duration=' || rec.duration || ', result=' || rec.win_type);
      END IF;
    END LOOP;

    IF lv_match_count = 0 THEN
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No matches found for this card.');
    ELSE
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Total matches listed: ' || lv_match_count);
    END IF;
  END IF;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Card not found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END report_wwe_card_matches;
/

DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT NUMBER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability
  lv_rows         NUMBER := 0;

  CURSOR cur_hub_channel IS
    SELECT report_rows.hub_state,
           report_rows.hub_city,
           report_rows.channel_type,
           report_rows.order_count,
           report_rows.gross_amount,
           report_rows.net_delivery_margin,
           report_rows.avg_distance_meters
      FROM (
            SELECT h.hub_state,
                   h.hub_city,
                   c.channel_type,
                   COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count,
                   ROUND(SUM(o.order_amount), 2) AS gross_amount,
                   ROUND(SUM(o.order_delivery_fee - o.order_delivery_cost), 2) AS net_delivery_margin,
                   ROUND(AVG(d.delivery_distance_meters), 2) AS avg_distance_meters
              FROM DELIVERY_CENTER.STORES s
              INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.HUBS h
                ON h.hub_id = s.hub_id
              INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.ORDERS o
                ON o.store_id = s.store_id
              INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.CHANNELS c
                ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id
              INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.DELIVERIES d
                ON d.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
             WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
               AND d.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED'
             GROUP BY h.hub_state,
                      h.hub_city,
                      c.channel_type
             ORDER BY COUNT(o.order_id) DESC
           ) report_rows
     WHERE ROWNUM <= co_report_limit;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Hub/channel delivery profitability report');

  FOR rec IN cur_hub_channel LOOP
    lv_rows := lv_rows + 1;

    IF rec.net_delivery_margin < 0 THEN
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Attention: negative delivery margin for ' || rec.hub_state || '/' || rec.channel_type);
    ELSE
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Healthy margin for ' || rec.hub_state || '/' || rec.channel_type);
    END IF;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('State=' || rec.hub_state || ', City=' || rec.hub_city || ', Channel Type=' || rec.channel_type || ', Orders=' || rec.order_count || ', Gross Amount=' || rec.gross_amount || ', Net Delivery Margin=' || rec.net_delivery_margin || ', Avg Distance Meters=' || rec.avg_distance_meters);
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No hub/channel delivery rows matched the report criteria.');
  END IF;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;
/

DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability
  lv_rows_found  NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Stacking solution performance report');

  FOR rec IN (
    SELECT report_rows.name,
           report_rows.version,
           report_rows.score,
           report_rows.nb_model,
           report_rows.nb_feature,
           report_rows.scored_model_count,
           report_rows.avg_test_score,
           report_rows.best_test_score
      FROM (
            SELECT s.name,
                   s.version,
                   s.score,
                   s.nb_model,
                   s.nb_feature,
                   COUNT(ms.model) AS scored_model_count,
                   AVG(ms.test_score) AS avg_test_score,
                   MAX(ms.test_score) AS best_test_score
              FROM STACKING.SOLUTION s
              LEFT OUTER JOIN STACKING.MODEL_SCORE ms
                ON ms.name = s.name
               AND ms.version = s.version
             GROUP BY s.name,
                      s.version,
                      s.score,
                      s.nb_model,
                      s.nb_feature
             ORDER BY s.score DESC,
                      s.name,
                      s.version
           ) report_rows
     WHERE ROWNUM <= co_report_limit
  ) LOOP
    lv_rows_found := lv_rows_found + 1;

    IF rec.avg_test_score IS NULL THEN
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Solution ' || rec.name || ' version ' || TO_CHAR(rec.version) || ' has no model score rows.');
    ELSE
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Solution ' || rec.name || ' version ' || TO_CHAR(rec.version) || ' score=' || TO_CHAR(rec.score) || ', models=' || TO_CHAR(rec.nb_model) || ', features=' || TO_CHAR(rec.nb_feature) || ', scored_models=' || TO_CHAR(rec.scored_model_count) || ', avg_test=' || TO_CHAR(rec.avg_test_score) || ', best_test=' || TO_CHAR(rec.best_test_score));
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows_found = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No solution rows were found.');
  END IF;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;
/

Now turn the CPI-U area/item work into an analyst-friendly "data quality gate" anonymous PL/SQL block. Using the same Area/Item from the earlier turns, detect suspicious CPI observations for the latest year in that series and print them.

Rules:
Work only on the latest year for the resolved series_id.
Flag any row where VALUE is not a valid numeric.
For numeric VALUEs, flag outliers where the absolute percent change versus the previous period (by C_DATE ordering) is greater than a threshold (declare the threshold as a variable).
Print up to 15 flagged rows with the date, period, raw value, and computed percent change.

Also, include a cross-table check: report how many observations exist for that same series_id in CPI_U vs C_CPI_U for the latest year (to spot coverage gaps).

Make the block fully defensive with exception handling, and ensure the outlier logic uses clear control flow.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: Anonymous Block
Parameters: None
Output: DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Series: ' || lv_series_id || ' | Latest year: ' || lv_latest_year)
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Coverage check for latest year -> CPI_U=' || lv_cnt_cpi_u_year || ', C_CPI_U=' || lv_cnt_c_cpi_u_year)
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Flagged observations (max rows = ' || co_report_limit || ', threshold=' || TO_CHAR(lv_pct_threshold) || '%):')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('  ' || TO_CHAR(r.c_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' | ' || r.period || ' | ' || r.value || ' | pct_change=' || TO_CHAR(r.pct_change))
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No flagged observations found for the latest year.')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.')
Exception Handling: WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
DECLARE
  -- Inputs (same business keys as previous turns)
  lv_area_name  BLS.CPI_U.area_name%TYPE := 'U.S. city average';
  lv_item_name  BLS.CPI_U.item_name%TYPE := 'All items';

  lv_series_id     BLS.CPI_U.series_id%TYPE;
  lv_latest_year   BLS.CPI_U.year%TYPE;

  lv_cnt_cpi_u_year    NUMBER;
  lv_cnt_c_cpi_u_year  NUMBER;

  lv_pct_threshold  NUMBER := 20; -- percent change threshold for flagging

  lv_flagged_cnt NUMBER := 0;

  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability
BEGIN
  -- Resolve series.
  SELECT c.series_id
    INTO lv_series_id
    FROM BLS.CPI_U c
   WHERE c.area_name = lv_area_name
     AND c.item_name = lv_item_name
   GROUP BY c.series_id;

  -- Latest year.
  SELECT MAX(c.year)
    INTO lv_latest_year
    FROM BLS.CPI_U c
   WHERE c.series_id = lv_series_id;

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Series: ' || lv_series_id || ' | Latest year: ' || lv_latest_year);

  -- Coverage check for the latest year in both CPI tables.
  SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO lv_cnt_cpi_u_year
    FROM BLS.CPI_U c
   WHERE c.series_id = lv_series_id
     AND c.year = lv_latest_year;

  SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO lv_cnt_c_cpi_u_year
    FROM BLS.C_CPI_U cc
   WHERE cc.series_id = lv_series_id
     AND cc.year = lv_latest_year;

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Coverage check for latest year -> CPI_U=' || lv_cnt_cpi_u_year || ', C_CPI_U=' || lv_cnt_c_cpi_u_year);

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Flagged observations (max rows = ' || co_report_limit || ', threshold=' || TO_CHAR(lv_pct_threshold) || '%):');

  FOR r IN (
    WITH ordered_vals AS (
      SELECT c.c_date,
             c.period,
             c.value,
             CASE
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(c.value, '^[-]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') THEN TO_NUMBER(c.value)
               ELSE NULL
             END AS value_num,
             LAG(
               CASE
                 WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(c.value, '^[-]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') THEN TO_NUMBER(c.value)
                 ELSE NULL
               END
             ) OVER (ORDER BY c.c_date) AS prev_value_num
        FROM BLS.CPI_U c
       WHERE c.series_id = lv_series_id
         AND c.year = lv_latest_year
    ), flagged AS (
      SELECT o.c_date,
             o.period,
             o.value,
             CASE
               WHEN o.value_num IS NULL THEN NULL
               WHEN o.prev_value_num IS NULL THEN NULL
               WHEN o.prev_value_num = 0 THEN NULL
               ELSE ROUND(ABS((o.value_num - o.prev_value_num) / o.prev_value_num) * 100, 2)
             END AS pct_change,
             CASE
               WHEN o.value_num IS NULL THEN 1
               WHEN o.prev_value_num IS NULL THEN 0
               WHEN o.prev_value_num = 0 THEN 0
               WHEN ROUND(ABS((o.value_num - o.prev_value_num) / o.prev_value_num) * 100, 2) > lv_pct_threshold THEN 1
               ELSE 0
             END AS is_flagged
        FROM ordered_vals o
    )
    SELECT f.c_date, f.period, f.value, f.pct_change
      FROM flagged f
     WHERE f.is_flagged = 1
     ORDER BY f.c_date DESC
     FETCH FIRST co_report_limit ROWS ONLY
  ) LOOP
    lv_flagged_cnt := lv_flagged_cnt + 1;
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('  ' || TO_CHAR(r.c_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' | ' || r.period || ' | ' || r.value || ' | pct_change=' || TO_CHAR(r.pct_change));
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_flagged_cnt = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No flagged observations found for the latest year.');
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;
/

DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_landmark     SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATIONS.landmark%TYPE := 'San Francisco';
  lv_rows_printed PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Utilization ranking for Landmark=' || lv_landmark || ' (max rows=' || co_report_limit || '):');

  FOR r IN (
    WITH latest_status AS (
      SELECT bs.station_id,
             MAX(bs.time) AS max_time
        FROM SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATUS bs
       GROUP BY bs.station_id
    ),
    station_latest AS (
      SELECT s.station_id,
             s.name,
             bs.time,
             TO_NUMBER(bs.bikes_available) AS bikes_num,
             TO_NUMBER(bs.docks_available) AS docks_num
        FROM SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATIONS s
        JOIN latest_status ls
          ON ls.station_id = s.station_id
        JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATUS bs
          ON bs.station_id = ls.station_id
         AND bs.time = ls.max_time
       WHERE s.landmark = lv_landmark
         AND (TO_NUMBER(bs.bikes_available) + TO_NUMBER(bs.docks_available)) > 0
    ),
    ranked AS (
      SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY (sl.bikes_num / (sl.bikes_num + sl.docks_num)) DESC,
                        sl.station_id ASC
             ) AS rn,
             sl.station_id,
             sl.name,
             sl.time,
             (sl.bikes_num / (sl.bikes_num + sl.docks_num)) AS utilization
        FROM station_latest sl
    )
    SELECT r2.rn,
           r2.station_id,
           r2.name,
           r2.time,
           r2.utilization
      FROM ranked r2
     ORDER BY r2.rn
  ) LOOP
    EXIT WHEN lv_rows_printed >= co_report_limit;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Rank ' || r.rn || ': ' || r.station_id || ' | ' || r.name || ' | ' || TO_CHAR(r.time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' | util=' || TO_CHAR(r.utilization, '0.000'));
    lv_rows_printed := lv_rows_printed + 1;
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows_printed = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No stations with status found for this landmark.');
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;
/

question:
Start the baseball operations review by pulling a compact team-performance snapshot for the most recent season in the TEAM table. Show the strongest clubs first, include their win-loss context, run differential, ERA, attendance, and assign a simple performance band so the next steps can drill into individual teams.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: Anonymous Block
Parameters: None
Output: 'Team performance snapshot for season ' || lv_year
rec.team_id || ' | ' || rec.name || ' | W-L ' || rec.w || '-' || rec.l || ' | WinPct ' || TO_CHAR(rec.win_pct, '0.000') || ' | RunDiff ' || rec.run_diff || ' | ERA ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(rec.era), 'N/A') || ' | Attendance ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(rec.attendance), 'N/A') || ' | Band ' || rec.performance_band
'No teams were found for the latest season.'
'No seasons are available in BASEBALL.TEAM.'
Exception Handling: WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
SET SERVEROUTPUT ON;
DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for executive readability
  lv_year         BASEBALL.TEAM.year%TYPE;
  lv_rows         PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  SELECT MAX(t.year)
    INTO lv_year
    FROM BASEBALL.TEAM t;

  IF lv_year IS NULL THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No seasons are available in BASEBALL.TEAM.');
  ELSE
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Team performance snapshot for season ' || lv_year);

    FOR rec IN (
      SELECT ranked.team_id,
             ranked.name,
             ranked.w,
             ranked.l,
             ranked.win_pct,
             ranked.run_diff,
             ranked.era,
             ranked.attendance,
             ranked.performance_band
        FROM (
          SELECT t.team_id,
                 t.name,
                 NVL(t.w, 0) AS w,
                 NVL(t.l, 0) AS l,
                 CASE
                   WHEN NVL(t.w, 0) + NVL(t.l, 0) = 0 THEN 0
                   ELSE ROUND(NVL(t.w, 0) / (NVL(t.w, 0) + NVL(t.l, 0)), 3)
                 END AS win_pct,
                 NVL(t.r, 0) - NVL(t.ra, 0) AS run_diff,
                 t.era,
                 t.attendance,
                 CASE
                   WHEN NVL(t.w, 0) >= 95 THEN 'Elite'
                   WHEN NVL(t.w, 0) >= 85 THEN 'Contender'
                   WHEN NVL(t.w, 0) >= NVL(t.l, 0) THEN 'Competitive'
                   ELSE 'Rebuild Watch'
                 END AS performance_band
            FROM BASEBALL.TEAM t
           WHERE t.year = lv_year
           ORDER BY NVL(t.w, 0) DESC, t.team_id ASC
        ) ranked
       WHERE ROWNUM <= co_report_limit
    ) LOOP
      lv_rows := lv_rows + 1;
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(rec.team_id || ' | ' || rec.name || ' | W-L ' || rec.w || '-' || rec.l || ' | WinPct ' || TO_CHAR(rec.win_pct, '0.000') || ' | RunDiff ' || rec.run_diff || ' | ERA ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(rec.era), 'N/A') || ' | Attendance ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(rec.attendance), 'N/A') || ' | Band ' || rec.performance_band);
    END LOOP;

    IF lv_rows = 0 THEN
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No teams were found for the latest season.');
    END IF;
  END IF;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;
/

'No batting records were found for this team and season.'
Exception Handling: WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No team rows found for the supplied season and team.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple team rows returned for the supplied request.'

reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE report_team_player_value(
  p_year    IN BASEBALL.TEAM.year%TYPE,
  p_team_id IN BASEBALL.TEAM.team_id%TYPE
) AS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit drill-down output for analyst review
  lv_team_name    BASEBALL.TEAM.name%TYPE;
  lv_probe_team   BASEBALL.TEAM.team_id%TYPE;
  lv_rows         PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  IF p_year IS NULL OR p_team_id IS NULL THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Year and team are required.');
  ELSE
    IF UPPER(p_team_id) = 'ALL' THEN
      SELECT t.team_id
        INTO lv_probe_team
        FROM BASEBALL.TEAM t
       WHERE t.year = p_year;
    END IF;

    SELECT t.name
      INTO lv_team_name
      FROM BASEBALL.TEAM t
     WHERE t.year = p_year
       AND t.team_id = p_team_id;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Player value review for ' || lv_team_name || ' (' || p_team_id || ') in ' || p_year);

    FOR rec IN (
      SELECT limited.player_id,
             limited.player_name,
             limited.total_ab,
             limited.total_hits,
             limited.total_hr,
             limited.total_rbi,
             limited.salary_amount
        FROM (
          SELECT b.player_id,
                 TRIM(p.name_first || ' ' || p.name_last) AS player_name,
                 SUM(NVL(b.ab, 0)) AS total_ab,
                 SUM(NVL(b.h, 0)) AS total_hits,
                 SUM(NVL(b.hr, 0)) AS total_hr,
                 SUM(NVL(b.rbi, 0)) AS total_rbi,
                 MAX(s.salary) AS salary_amount
            FROM BASEBALL.BATTING b
            INNER JOIN BASEBALL.PLAYER p
              ON p.player_id = b.player_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN BASEBALL.SALARY s
              ON s.player_id = b.player_id
             AND s.year = b.year
             AND s.team_id = b.team_id
           WHERE b.year = p_year
             AND b.team_id = p_team_id
           GROUP BY b.player_id, TRIM(p.name_first || ' ' || p.name_last)
          HAVING SUM(NVL(b.ab, 0)) > 0
           ORDER BY SUM(NVL(b.rbi, 0)) DESC, SUM(NVL(b.hr, 0)) DESC, b.player_id ASC
        ) limited
       WHERE ROWNUM <= co_report_limit
    ) LOOP
      lv_rows := lv_rows + 1;
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(rec.player_id || ' | ' || rec.player_name || ' | AB ' || rec.total_ab || ' | H ' || rec.total_hits || ' | HR ' || rec.total_hr || ' | RBI ' || rec.total_rbi || ' | Salary ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(rec.salary_amount), 'N/A'));
    END LOOP;

    IF lv_rows = 0 THEN
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No batting records were found for this team and season.');
    END IF;
  END IF;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No team rows found for the supplied season and team.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple team rows returned for the supplied request.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END report_team_player_value;
/

BEGIN

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Region name is required.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Region: ' || p_region_name || ' (top ' || co_report_limit || ' stations by utilization)');

  FOR r IN (
    WITH region_match AS (
      SELECT rgn.region_id
        FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_REGIONS rgn
       WHERE rgn.name = p_region_name
    ), latest_status AS (
      SELECT st.station_id,
             MAX(TO_NUMBER(st.last_reported)) AS last_reported_num
        FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_STATUS st
       GROUP BY st.station_id
    )
    SELECT si.name,
           TO_NUMBER(si.capacity) AS capacity_num,
           TO_NUMBER(ss.num_bikes_available) AS bikes_avail_num,
           CASE
             WHEN TO_NUMBER(si.capacity) = 0 THEN 0
             ELSE TO_NUMBER(ss.num_bikes_available) / TO_NUMBER(si.capacity)
           END AS utilization_ratio
      FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si
      INNER JOIN region_match rm
        ON rm.region_id = si.region_id
      INNER JOIN latest_status ls
        ON ls.station_id = si.station_id
      INNER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_STATUS ss
        ON ss.station_id = ls.station_id
       AND TO_NUMBER(ss.last_reported) = ls.last_reported_num
     ORDER BY utilization_ratio DESC, si.name ASC
     FETCH FIRST co_report_limit ROWS ONLY
  ) LOOP
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'Station: ' || r.name ||
      ' | Capacity=' || r.capacity_num ||
      ' | BikesAvail=' || r.bikes_avail_num ||
      ' | Utilization=' || TO_CHAR(r.utilization_ratio * 100, 'FM9990D00') || '%'
    );
  END LOOP;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No stations/status found for region.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Bad numeric data encountered in capacity or availability.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END report_region_station_utilization;
/

DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT NUMBER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability
  lv_rows         NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Top stacking solution summary:');

  FOR rec IN (
    SELECT ranked.name,
           ranked.version,
           ranked.score,
           ranked.nb_model,
           ranked.nb_feature,
           ranked.problem_type,
           ranked.problem_target
      FROM (
            SELECT s.name,
                   s.version,
                   s.score,
                   s.nb_model,
                   s.nb_feature,
                   p.type AS problem_type,
                   p.target AS problem_target
              FROM STACKING.SOLUTION s
              LEFT OUTER JOIN STACKING.PROBLEM p
                ON p.name = s.name
             WHERE s.score IS NOT NULL
             ORDER BY s.score DESC, s.name ASC, s.version DESC
           ) ranked
     WHERE ROWNUM <= co_report_limit
  ) LOOP
    lv_rows := lv_rows + 1;
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Solution=' || rec.name || ', Version=' || rec.version || ', Score=' || rec.score || ', Models=' || rec.nb_model || ', Features=' || rec.nb_feature || ', ProblemType=' || rec.problem_type || ', Target=' || rec.problem_target);
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No scored solutions found.');
  END IF;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE dei_hiring_vs_exits(
  p_workforce   IN GOOGLE_DEI.DAR_INTERSECTIONAL_HIRING.workforce%TYPE,
  p_report_year IN GOOGLE_DEI.DAR_INTERSECTIONAL_HIRING.report_year%TYPE
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability
  lv_row_count    PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Compare Hiring vs Exits for Workforce=' || p_workforce || ', Report Year=' || p_report_year);

  FOR r IN (
    SELECT
      h.gender_us,
      NVL(TO_NUMBER(h.race_asian), 0)  AS hiring_asian,
      NVL(TO_NUMBER(e.race_asian), 0)  AS exits_asian,
      CASE
        WHEN NVL(TO_NUMBER(h.race_asian), 0) > NVL(TO_NUMBER(e.race_asian), 0) THEN 'IMPROVED'
        ELSE 'NOT_IMPROVED'
      END AS flag
    FROM GOOGLE_DEI.DAR_INTERSECTIONAL_HIRING h
    INNER JOIN GOOGLE_DEI.DAR_INTERSECTIONAL_EXITS_REPRESENTATION e
      ON e.workforce = h.workforce
     AND e.report_year = h.report_year
     AND e.gender_us = h.gender_us
    WHERE h.workforce = p_workforce
      AND h.report_year = p_report_year
      AND ROWNUM <= co_report_limit
    ORDER BY h.gender_us
  ) LOOP
    lv_row_count := lv_row_count + 1;
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'Gender=' || r.gender_us ||
      ', Hiring_Asian=' || r.hiring_asian ||
      ', Exits_Asian=' || r.exits_asian ||
      ', Flag=' || r.flag
    );
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_row_count = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No comparable hiring/exits rows found for the requested workforce/year.');
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END dei_hiring_vs_exits;
/

SET SERVEROUTPUT ON;
DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT NUMBER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability.
  lv_rows_printed NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Delivery center performance snapshot');

  FOR rec IN (
    WITH hub_channel_metrics AS (
      SELECT h.hub_name,
             h.hub_city,
             c.channel_name,
             COUNT(*) AS order_count,
             ROUND(AVG(o.order_metric_cycle_time), 2) AS avg_cycle_time
        FROM DELIVERY_CENTER.ORDERS o
        INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.STORES s
          ON s.store_id = o.store_id
        INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.HUBS h
          ON h.hub_id = s.hub_id
        INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.CHANNELS c
          ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id
       WHERE o.order_metric_cycle_time IS NOT NULL
       GROUP BY h.hub_name, h.hub_city, c.channel_name
    )
    SELECT limited_metrics.hub_name,
           limited_metrics.hub_city,
           limited_metrics.channel_name,
           limited_metrics.order_count,
           limited_metrics.avg_cycle_time
      FROM (
            SELECT m.hub_name,
                   m.hub_city,
                   m.channel_name,
                   m.order_count,
                   m.avg_cycle_time
              FROM hub_channel_metrics m
             ORDER BY m.order_count DESC, m.avg_cycle_time DESC
           ) limited_metrics
     WHERE ROWNUM <= co_report_limit
  ) LOOP
    lv_rows_printed := lv_rows_printed + 1;
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Hub: ' || rec.hub_name || ' | City: ' || rec.hub_city || ' | Channel: ' || rec.channel_name || ' | Orders: ' || rec.order_count || ' | Avg cycle: ' || rec.avg_cycle_time);
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows_printed = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No rows matched the snapshot criteria.');
  END IF;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE report_top_providers_by_state(
  p_state IN CMS_MEDICARE.HOSPICE_PROVIDERS.state%TYPE
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  CURSOR cur_providers IS
    WITH unified AS (
      SELECT hp.provider_id AS provider_id,
             'HOSPICE' AS provider_type,
             hp.name AS provider_name,
             hp.city AS city,
             hp.state AS state,
             TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(hp.total_medicare_payment_amount, ',', '')) AS medicare_payment_amount
        FROM CMS_MEDICARE.HOSPICE_PROVIDERS hp
       WHERE (p_state IS NULL OR hp.state = p_state)
         AND hp.total_medicare_payment_amount IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT hha.provider_id AS provider_id,
             'HOME_HEALTH' AS provider_type,
             hha.agency_name AS provider_name,
             hha.city AS city,
             hha.state AS state,
             TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(hha.total_hha_medicare_payment_amount_non_lupa, ',', '')) AS medicare_payment_amount
        FROM CMS_MEDICARE.HOME_HEALTH_AGENCIES hha
       WHERE (p_state IS NULL OR hha.state = p_state)
         AND hha.total_hha_medicare_payment_amount_non_lupa IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT u.provider_id,
           u.provider_type,

'No rows matched the requested year/county filter.'

WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE report_birth_payment_gap(
  p_year        IN SDOH_CDC_WONDER_NATALITY.COUNTY_NATALITY.year%TYPE,
  p_county_like IN SDOH_CDC_WONDER_NATALITY.COUNTY_NATALITY.county_of_residence%TYPE
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_rows_printed PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Birth vs Payment Gap Report (max rows = ' || co_report_limit || ')');
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Filters: year=' || TO_CHAR(p_year, 'YYYY') || ', county_like=' || NVL(p_county_like, '<NULL>'));
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('COUNTY', 28) || ' ' || RPAD('FIPS', 10) || ' ' || LPAD('BIRTHS_ALL', 12) || ' ' || LPAD('BIRTHS_PAY', 12) || ' ' || LPAD('DIFF', 12));

  FOR rec IN (
    WITH pay AS (
      SELECT
        p.county_of_residence_fips,
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(p.births), '^[-]?[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(p.births))
            ELSE 0
          END
        ) AS births_payment_sum
      FROM SDOH_CDC_WONDER_NATALITY.COUNTY_NATALITY_BY_PAYMENT p
      WHERE p.year = p_year
      GROUP BY p.county_of_residence_fips
    )
    SELECT
      n.county_of_residence,
      n.county_of_residence_fips,
      CASE
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(n.births), '^[-]?[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(n.births))
        ELSE 0
      END AS births_all,
      NVL(pay.births_payment_sum, 0) AS births_payment_sum
    FROM SDOH_CDC_WONDER_NATALITY.COUNTY_NATALITY n
    LEFT OUTER JOIN pay
      ON pay.county_of_residence_fips = n.county_of_residence_fips
    WHERE n.year = p_year
      AND (p_county_like IS NULL OR UPPER(n.county_of_residence) LIKE UPPER(p_county_like))
    ORDER BY ABS(
      (CASE
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(n.births), '^[-]?[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(n.births))
        ELSE 0
      END) - NVL(pay.births_payment_sum, 0)
    ) DESC,
    n.county_of_residence
  ) LOOP
    lv_rows_printed := lv_rows_printed + 1;
    EXIT WHEN lv_rows_printed > co_report_limit;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      RPAD(rec.county_of_residence, 28) || ' ' ||
      RPAD(rec.county_of_residence_fips, 10) || ' ' ||
      LPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.births_all), 12) || ' ' ||
      LPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.births_payment_sum), 12) || ' ' ||
      LPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.births_all - rec.births_payment_sum), 12)
    );
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows_printed = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No rows matched the requested year/county filter.');
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END report_birth_payment_gap;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE triage_birth_data_quality(
  p_year        IN SDOH_CDC_WONDER_NATALITY.COUNTY_NATALITY.year%TYPE,

) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_rows_printed PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Data Quality Triage (max rows = ' || co_report_limit || ')');
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Filters: year=' || TO_CHAR(p_year, 'YYYY') || ', county_like=' || NVL(p_county_like, '<NULL>'));
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('COUNTY', 28) || ' ' || RPAD('FIPS', 10) || ' ' || LPAD('BIRTHS_ALL', 12) || ' ' || LPAD('BIRTHS_PAY', 12) || ' ' || 'LABEL');

  FOR rec IN (
    WITH pay AS (
      SELECT
        p.county_of_residence_fips,
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(p.births), '^[-]?[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(p.births))
            ELSE 0
          END
        ) AS births_payment_sum
      FROM SDOH_CDC_WONDER_NATALITY.COUNTY_NATALITY_BY_PAYMENT p
      WHERE p.year = p_year
      GROUP BY p.county_of_residence_fips
    )
    SELECT
      n.county_of_residence,
      n.county_of_residence_fips,
      CASE
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(n.births), '^[-]?[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(n.births))
        ELSE 0
      END AS births_all,
      NVL(pay.births_payment_sum, 0) AS births_payment_sum,
      CASE
        WHEN (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(n.births), '^[-]?[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(n.births)) ELSE 0 END) <= 0
             AND NVL(pay.births_payment_sum, 0) > 0
        THEN 'ALL_MISSING_OR_ZERO_BUT_PAYMENT_POSITIVE'
        WHEN (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(n.births), '^[-]?[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(n.births)) ELSE 0 END) > 0
             AND NVL(pay.births_payment_sum, 0) <= 0
        THEN 'PAYMENT_MISSING_OR_ZERO_BUT_ALL_POSITIVE'
        ELSE 'CONSISTENT'
      END AS triage_label
    FROM SDOH_CDC_WONDER_NATALITY.COUNTY_NATALITY n
    LEFT OUTER JOIN pay
      ON pay.county_of_residence_fips = n.county_of_residence_fips
    WHERE n.year = p_year
      AND (p_county_like IS NULL OR UPPER(n.county_of_residence) LIKE UPPER(p_county_like))
    ORDER BY triage_label, n.county_of_residence

Requirements:
Procedure Name: Anonymous Block
Parameters: None
Output: 'Low stock replenishment check'
'Product: ' || rec.product_name || ' | On hand: ' || rec.on_hand_qty || ' | Minimum: ' || rec.qty_minimum || ' | Suggested purchase: ' || rec.qty_purchase || ' | Status: ' || rec.stock_status

DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT NUMBER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability
  lv_rows         NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Low stock replenishment check');

  FOR rec IN (
    WITH inventory_totals AS (
      SELECT i.product_id,
             SUM(i.qty) AS on_hand_qty
        FROM ORACLE_SQL.INVENTORY i
       GROUP BY i.product_id
    )
    SELECT limited.product_name,
           limited.on_hand_qty,
           limited.qty_minimum,
           limited.qty_purchase,
           limited.stock_status
      FROM (
            SELECT p.name AS product_name,
                   NVL(it.on_hand_qty, 0) AS on_hand_qty,
                   pm.qty_minimum,
                   pm.qty_purchase,
                   CASE
                     WHEN NVL(it.on_hand_qty, 0) = 0 THEN 'OUT OF STOCK'
                     ELSE 'BELOW MINIMUM'
                   END AS stock_status
              FROM ORACLE_SQL.PRODUCTS p
              INNER JOIN ORACLE_SQL.PRODUCT_MINIMUMS pm
                ON pm.product_id = p.id
              LEFT OUTER JOIN inventory_totals it
                ON it.product_id = p.id
             WHERE NVL(it.on_hand_qty, 0) < pm.qty_minimum
             ORDER BY pm.qty_minimum DESC, p.name
           ) limited
     WHERE ROWNUM <= co_report_limit
  ) LOOP
    lv_rows := lv_rows + 1;

Now compare the low-stock picture with actual order demand. Report orders where the requested product quantity is greater than the quantity currently on hand so the picking team can see fulfillment risk before building pick lists.

Requirements:

Parameters: None
Output: 'Open order fulfillment risk check'
'Order: ' || rec.order_id || ' | Customer: ' || rec.customer_name || ' | Product: ' || rec.product_name || ' | Needed: ' || rec.ordered_qty || ' | On hand: ' || rec.on_hand_qty || ' | Shortage: ' || rec.shortage_qty

'No data found.'

WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'

DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT NUMBER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability
  lv_rows         NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Open order fulfillment risk check');

  FOR rec IN (
    WITH inventory_totals AS (
      SELECT i.product_id,
             SUM(i.qty) AS on_hand_qty
        FROM ORACLE_SQL.INVENTORY i
       GROUP BY i.product_id
    ),
    order_demand AS (
      SELECT ol.order_id,
             ol.product_id,
             SUM(ol.qty) AS ordered_qty
        FROM ORACLE_SQL.ORDERLINES ol
       GROUP BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id
    )
    SELECT limited.order_id,
           limited.customer_name,
           limited.product_name,
           limited.ordered_qty,
           limited.on_hand_qty,
           limited.shortage_qty
      FROM (
            SELECT od.order_id,
                   c.name AS customer_name,
                   p.name AS product_name,
                   od.ordered_qty,
                   NVL(it.on_hand_qty, 0) AS on_hand_qty,
                   od.ordered_qty - NVL(it.on_hand_qty, 0) AS shortage_qty
              FROM order_demand od
              INNER JOIN ORACLE_SQL.ORDERS o
                ON o.id = od.order_id
              INNER JOIN ORACLE_SQL.CUSTOMERS c
                ON c.id = o.customer_id
              INNER JOIN ORACLE_SQL.PRODUCTS p
                ON p.id = od.product_id
              LEFT OUTER JOIN inventory_totals it
                ON it.product_id = od.product_id
             WHERE od.ordered_qty > NVL(it.on_hand_qty, 0)
             ORDER BY shortage_qty DESC, od.order_id
           ) limited
     WHERE ROWNUM <= co_report_limit
  ) LOOP
    lv_rows := lv_rows + 1;
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Order: ' || rec.order_id || ' | Customer: ' || rec.customer_name || ' | Product: ' || rec.product_name || ' | Needed: ' || rec.ordered_qty || ' | On hand: ' || rec.on_hand_qty || ' | Shortage: ' || rec.shortage_qty);
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No fulfillment risks found.');
  END IF;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;

DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability
  lv_rows         NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('IPL match scoring overview');

  FOR rec IN (
    SELECT ordered_scores.match_id,
           ordered_scores.team_1_name,
           ordered_scores.team_2_name,
           ordered_scores.total_runs
      FROM (
            SELECT m.match_id,
                   t1.name AS team_1_name,
                   t2.name AS team_2_name,
                   SUM(NVL(bs.runs_scored, 0) + NVL(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs
              FROM IPL.MATCH m
              INNER JOIN IPL.TEAM t1
                ON t1.team_id = m.team_1
              INNER JOIN IPL.TEAM t2
                ON t2.team_id = m.team_2
              LEFT OUTER JOIN IPL.BALL_BY_BALL b
                ON b.match_id = m.match_id
              LEFT OUTER JOIN IPL.BATSMAN_SCORED bs
                ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
               AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
               AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
               AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
              LEFT OUTER JOIN IPL.EXTRA_RUNS er
                ON er.match_id = b.match_id
               AND er.over_id = b.over_id
               AND er.ball_id = b.ball_id
               AND er.innings_no = b.innings_no
             GROUP BY m.match_id, t1.name, t2.name
             ORDER BY total_runs DESC, m.match_id
           ) ordered_scores
     WHERE ROWNUM <= co_report_limit
  ) LOOP
    lv_rows := lv_rows + 1;
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Match ' || rec.match_id || ': ' || rec.team_1_name || ' vs ' || rec.team_2_name || ' - ' || rec.total_runs || ' runs');
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No match scoring rows found.');
  END IF;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;
